title: Developer Advocate - Service Management
Experienced Real Estate Cold Caller / Wholesaling Virtual Assistant (Full-Time)
description:
We are an established real estate investment company looking for a motivated, high-energy Real Estate Cold Caller to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for outbound cold calling to property owners, qualifying leads, and identifying motivated sellers who want to sell their properties off-market.

You will be working with a fast-paced multi-line power dialer system, so you must be comfortable managing a high volume of outbound calls and updating information in our CRM in real-time.

Core Responsibilities:

• Make high-volume outbound cold calls to real estate lead lists using our multi-line dialer system.

• Prequalify property owners based on their motivation, property condition, timeline, and asking price.

• Accurately log all notes, call dispositions, and seller details into our CRM platform immediately during/after calls.

• Follow up with leads who requested a callback or showed initial interest.

• Meet daily and weekly key performance indicators (KPIs) for talk time and qualified leads generated. 



Requirements



• Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of proven experience cold calling in the U.S. Real Estate Wholesaling industry.

• Communication: Exceptional English speaking and listening skills with a neutral or near-native accent. Ability to handle objections smoothly and build rapport quickly over the phone.

• Technical Setup:

 • A reliable, high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps download/upload, preferably with a backup power/internet solution).

 • A quiet, distraction-free home office workspace.

 • A high-quality USB headset with noise-canceling capabilities.

 • A dependable computer/laptop with at least 8GB of RAM.

• Software Skills: Familiarity with multi-line power dialers (e.g., Mojo, BatchDialer, ReadyMode) and real estate CRMs (e.g., Podio, REsimpli).

• Characteristics: High level of discipline, self-motivated, resilient against rejection, and a strong work ethic.



To apply, please reply with the subject line 'I am your next Rockstar Caller!' and include a link to a 1-minute audio recording introducing yourself and summarizing your real estate cold-calling experience. Applications without an audio link will not be reviewed.

title: Amazon wholesale FBA-Full Account Management
description:
Title: Amazon Wholesale FBA — Full Account Manager (Profit-Share)



Setting up an Amazon wholesale FBA store 

Looking for a full account manager to run it end-to-end on profit-share.



Scope: product research and sourcing from authorized distributors, brand

ungating, listing creation and optimization, Buy Box repricing, PPC

(Sponsored Products) management, shipment plans, inventory and reorder

management, account health monitoring.



Compensation: profit-share per ASIN on sell-through — a % of net profit

per product, paid as each ASIN sells through. Net profit = revenue minus

all costs: product cost, freight, Amazon referral and FBA fees, ad spend,

software, returns. No flat retainer.



To apply, answer all five:

1. Your proposed profit-share % of net profit per ASIN.

2. How you define and report net profit (which costs you deduct).

3. Your wholesale track record — managed revenue, active accounts — and

   whether you can show live Seller Central on a video call.

4. Two client references I can contact directly.

5. Your proposed settlement terms — payout timing per ASIN, dead-stock

   handling, exit terms.



No generic pitches — specific answers only.

title: CNC Machine Shops (Fusion 360): Paid Licensing of Archived 3-Axis Parts
description:
Summary

Do you run a CNC shop or have years of machined customer jobs sitting in your archive? We'll pay you to license them.

We're a San Francisco-based, YC-backed startup building real-world training data for physical AI and robotics. We need complete file packages for parts that were actually cut on a machine, not just modeled or simulated. This is a volume engagement: 50 parts minimum, up to 100 per partner, delivered in batches.

Compensation:

$100 USD per 5 approved bundles. 

What parts we want:

End-use parts made for a real customer job, 3-axis milled, with more than one setup or feature type. Metals and engineering plastics (POM, PEEK, nylon) are both fine. Typical examples include mould and die components (core/cavity inserts, sliders, lifters), housings and enclosures (gearbox, sensor, and pump housings), brackets, mounts and structural blocks, hydraulic manifolds and valve bodies, heat sinks and cold plates, machine-building parts (bearing blocks, end plates, carriages), robotics and drone parts (arm links, actuator housings, flanges), automotive and motorcycle parts (caliper brackets, throttle bodies, triple clamps), medical, lab, semiconductor, and optics components, consumer hardware like bike stems and camera cages, and heavy-equipment parts such as cylinder end caps and pivot blocks.



What we need for each part

- STEP model of the finished part as a single solid

- Original, editable Fusion 360 file (.f3d) with all setups and toolpaths

- Posted G-code for every setup (e.g., top + flip = two programs)

- Technical drawing (PDF) matching the model's dimensions

- Setup sheet: machine make/model and travels, material, stock size, workholding, number of setups, Fusion version and licence type

- A realistic quote/price estimate and a short provenance note: who machined it, where, and roughly when



Requirements:

- Parts must have been physically milled by you or your shop. Work that was only CAM-programmed for someone else's machine doesn't qualify.

- 3-axis milling only. No 3+2, 4-axis, 5-axis, router, or hybrid work.

- All CAM in Fusion 360 under a commercial licence. Files from Educational or Personal Use licences can't be accepted.

- The part must fit the travels of the machine you list, and all files must match each other.

- You must have the right to license every part. [Customer permission requirement.]



Not accepted:

- Fixtures and workholding: soft jaws, fixture plates, jigs, nests, or anything made for your own shop's use

- Wood, MDF, or foam

- Trivial parts: plain plates with holes, single-operation jobs, 2D profile cuts, engraving, nameplates

- More than 5 genuinely different designs per part family

- Parts never cut, test cuts, demo or training pieces

- Downloaded or open-source models

- Defence, export-controlled, or NDA parts

- Multi-body STEP files



How it works:

1. Pilot: Send 5 sample parts. Samples are paid at $20 each once approved and count toward your total. We review within 24 hours.

2. Batches: Deliver the rest in batches of [20]. Each batch is QC'd and paid on approval.

Parts that fail QC are returned for fixes, not paid as-is. Partners who consistently pass QC are offered ongoing contracts.

title: Social media reel editor.
description:
Short-Form Video Editor for Kitchen Design Brand



About us



Gatt Designs is a family-run kitchen design, supply and installation company based in Northern Ireland. We create kitchens and living spaces for clients across the region, and we’re building a stronger presence on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.



I’m looking for a creative, reliable video editor to turn my face-to-camera recordings into polished short-form videos that feel engaging, professional and personal.



The work



You’ll edit a minimum of 20 videos per month, with a regular target of around 5 videos per week. Some weeks may involve up to 7 videos, depending on the content schedule.



The footage will mainly be me speaking to camera about kitchen design, home renovations, materials, the business and advice for homeowners. Your role is to make each video clear, watchable and suited to social media.



What you’ll do



* Find or refine a strong opening hook to encourage people to keep watching

* Edit for pace, clarity and natural delivery, removing pauses, mistakes and unnecessary sections

* Add accurate, well-timed captions that are easy to read on a phone

* Use relevant B-roll, including kitchen and interior visuals, to support what I’m saying

* Add simple animations, text, transitions and visual touches where they improve the video

* Add suitable background music and balance the audio

* Reduce background noise and improve the overall sound quality

* Create an engaging thumbnail or cover image for each video

* Export videos in the correct vertical format for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

* Keep the editing style consistent across the content



The style we’re looking for



The videos should feel polished and professional, with strong hooks, clear captions, useful B-roll and clean animations. I like the style of kitchen and design creators such as Kitchens by Guy, especially the use of animated B-roll and thoughtful editing, but the content should still feel like Gatt Designs.



The editing should suit a real person speaking to camera. It shouldn’t feel overdone, overly flashy or full of distracting effects. The finished videos should be informative, engaging and natural.



What I’m looking for



* Experience editing short-form social media videos

* A strong portfolio of Reels, TikToks or YouTube Shorts

* Good judgement when shaping talking-head content and finding the strongest moments

* A good eye for design, interiors, kitchens or lifestyle content

* Strong attention to detail, especially with captions and audio

* Reliable communication and the ability to meet agreed deadlines

* Confidence working from footage, scripts and creative direction



Experience with tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or CapCut is welcome. Please mention which software you use.



To apply



Please include:



1. A link to examples of short-form videos you’ve edited

2. Your monthly rate for 20 videos

3. Your rate for 28 videos, if different

4. Your typical turnaround time

5. The editing software you use

6. A brief note about your experience with talking-head, home, kitchen or interior content



I’m looking for someone who can become a regular editing partner as we continue to grow Gatt Designs’ social media.

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Content Assistant
description:
Job Opening: Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Content Assistant



Remote | Part-time | Long-term collaboration | Based in the Philippines



About the role



I’m looking for a reliable, creative and proactive video editor and social media assistant to help me stay consistent on Instagram and TikTok.



I create Dutch-speaking content around lifestyle, personal development, business, content creation and entrepreneurship. I want to build a strong and consistent online presence without having to manage every editing, planning and posting task myself.



I’m looking for someone who can do more than just edit videos. I want someone who thinks along with me, spots opportunities, suggests content ideas and helps me turn the content I already create into as much valuable content as possible.



The goal is simple: create a consistent content system that allows us to publish regularly without me having to think about every single post.



1. Video editing



Your main responsibility will be editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.



Your tasks include:



* Editing talking-head videos in Dutch.

* Creating engaging hooks, adding captions and highlighting important words.

* Removing unnecessary pauses, filler words, mistakes and repetitive sections.

* Adding relevant B-roll, zoom-ins, transitions, sound effects and background music when appropriate.

* Improving pacing, storytelling and viewer retention.

* Creating clean, professional and visually engaging videos that match my personal brand.

* Exporting videos in the correct format and quality for Instagram and TikTok.

* Maintaining consistent editing quality across all content.



Important: My videos are spoken in Dutch. You must be able to understand spoken Dutch well enough to identify the key message, edit accurately, recognize important moments and create meaningful clips. Captions must also be accurate in Dutch. Automatic captions must always be checked and corrected.



You do not necessarily need to speak Dutch fluently, but you must demonstrate that you can work accurately with Dutch-language content.



2. Content repurposing



I want to get more value out of every video I record.



For example, one longer video could become several shorter videos, each focusing on a different point, lesson, story or strong hook.



Your responsibilities include:



* Identifying the strongest moments in longer recordings.

* Turning longer videos into multiple standalone short-form clips.

* Finding different hooks and angles within the same recording.

* Making sure each clip has a clear message and makes sense on its own.

* Suggesting alternative edits or opening hooks when they could improve the content.

* Avoiding repetitive clips that communicate essentially the same thing.



The goal is not simply to produce as many clips as possible. The goal is to create as many useful, engaging and relevant pieces of content as possible from the original footage.



3. Content batching and planning



I want us to work in content batches instead of handling every video as a separate task.



This means helping me organize and prepare content in advance so that we can maintain a consistent posting schedule.



Your responsibilities include:



* Helping organize raw footage and content ideas.

* Working with me to prepare content batches.

* Keeping track of which videos need editing, approval or publishing.

* Creating a clear content calendar.

* Suggesting relevant content ideas based on my existing content, audience and goals.

* Identifying opportunities to turn recurring themes into content series.

* Helping repurpose existing footage when I have limited time to record new videos.



I will provide the original footage, context and overall direction. I expect you to help turn that material into a structured, manageable content workflow.



4. Instagram and TikTok management



Once videos are edited and approved, you will help prepare and publish the content.



Tasks include:



* Preparing and scheduling approved videos on Instagram and TikTok.

* Writing or suggesting relevant captions.

* Suggesting suitable calls to action.

* Researching relevant keywords and hashtags when appropriate.

* Checking that videos, captions and covers are ready before publishing.

* Maintaining the agreed posting schedule.

* Keeping track of published content and upcoming posts.

* Flagging any technical issues or missing information before the scheduled publication date.



You must be comfortable working with social media scheduling and publishing tools. Access to my accounts will be provided through an agreed, secure process.



5. Creative thinking and initiative



This is a very important part of the role.



I don’t want someone who simply waits for instructions for every small task. I want someone who can think independently and identify opportunities to improve our content.



For example:



* “This part of the video would work better as a separate Reel.”

* “We could create three different hooks for this topic.”

* “This video would make a good recurring content series.”

* “We have enough footage here for next week’s posts.”

* “This editing style could make the message clearer.”

* “We should prepare these videos in advance to stay consistent.”



I value creative thinking, attention to detail, organization and solutions rather than just identifying problems.



You are encouraged to share ideas and recommendations. I will make the final decisions on content direction and brand positioning.



6. Requirements



I’m looking for someone who:



* Has experience editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.

* Can demonstrate a portfolio of relevant video-editing work.

* Can accurately understand spoken Dutch in video recordings.

* Can create accurate Dutch captions and subtitles.

* Understands short-form storytelling, hooks, pacing and audience retention.

* Is comfortable repurposing long-form content into shorter clips.

* Is organized, dependable and able to meet deadlines.

* Communicates clearly and proactively.

* Can work independently without needing constant supervision.

* Is open to feedback and can apply revisions correctly.

* Is interested in a long-term working relationship.



Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar editing software is welcome. Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, TikTok’s publishing tools and content calendars is an advantage.



7. Communication and workflow



I expect clear communication, realistic deadlines and consistent delivery.



You should:



* Confirm that you understand the task before starting when instructions are unclear.

* Let me know early if a deadline is at risk.

* Keep files organized and clearly labeled.

* Track the status of each video.

* Apply agreed feedback to future edits to reduce repeated revisions.

* Suggest improvements when you see an opportunity.



I want us to build a reliable system that becomes more efficient over time.



8. Application instructions



To apply, please provide:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Your video-editing portfolio, especially talking-head videos, Reels or TikToks.

3. Examples of videos where you have edited captions, hooks and short-form clips.

4. The editing software and scheduling tools you use.

5. Your experience working with content in Dutch or other languages you do not speak natively.

6. Your availability, preferred working hours and expected hourly or monthly rate.

7. A brief explanation of how you would turn one 10-minute talking-head video into multiple engaging short-form videos.



Please also include the word CONTENT SYSTEM at the beginning of your application so I know you have read the full job description.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small, paid editing test using Dutch-language footage. The test will help us evaluate your editing quality, understanding of the spoken content, caption accuracy and ability to identify strong short-form clips.



I’m looking for a dependable creative partner who wants to help build a consistent and effective content workflow over the long term.

title: Loan Processor – Australian Mortgage Broker (Application to Settlement)
description:

We are an Australian mortgage brokerage looking for an experienced Loan Processor to manage residential loan files from application through to settlement. You'll work directly with the broker, take each deal from his written instructions, prepare the client proposal, and own the file until it settles, keeping clients and lenders informed at every step.



What you'll do:



• Receive deals with written instructions from the broker and set them up in our CRM (MyCRM)

• Prepare the client Game Plan/proposal document, send it to the client and follow up until signed

What you'll do:

What we're looking for:

• Minimum 2 years' experience as a loan processor in an Australian mortgage brokerage (essential)

• Experience lodging through ApplyOnline and working with Australian lenders

• Experience with a broker CRM (MyCRM preferred)

• Settlement experience is a plus, but we'll train the right person

• Strong written and spoken English, confident communicating with Australian clients and lenders

• High attention to detail and able to follow a written process exactly

• Reliable internet and a quiet home workspace



Please only apply if you have at least 2 years' experience as a loan processor in an Australian mortgage brokerage.



Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday, 7:00am to 3:00pm Philippine time (9:00am to 5:00pm AEST)

Pay: ₱55,000 to ₱65,000 per month, depending on experience, plus 13th-month pay and statutory benefits from day one



Employment: Engaged as an employee through our Employer of Record in the Philippines



Start: Within 2 weeks of offer acceptance



To apply, send your CV and answer the following questions:



 1. How many years have you worked in Australian mortgage processing?

 2. Have you used MyCRM or other broker CRM software?If yes, explain what you can do independently in it.

You'll be responsible for developing 30 video ad concepts and 10 static ad concepts per month. Your responsibilities include:

title: Video Editor for Meta Ads (TikTok B-roll + AI Voiceover)
description:
About us

We are a fast-growing DTC footwear brand in the problem-solving space. Our footwear solves real, everyday problems, so our ads are not fashion or lifestyle looks: they are problem-and-solution ads. We run paid ads on
 and Instagram and we are looking for a full-time video editor to join us long term on a monthly salary.



Please read this first

Our ads are TikTok B-roll clips cut to an AI voiceover, with only a little AI-generated footage blended in where it is needed (it depends on the brief). We do not make fully AI-generated videos.



How our ads are made



We send you a script with three hooks and an example video: an ad we have swiped and reverse engineered.

You add the AI voiceover from the script.

You find and download real B-roll clips from TikTok that match each line of the script. Every clip must be sourced by you from TikTok. No stock footage (Pexels, Storyblocks, Envato or similar) is allowed.

For product shots, you use our product B-roll bank. If a product shot you need is not in the bank, you generate it yourself in Google Flow.

You follow the example video’s format and editing style exactly, and edit it all into a fast, scroll-stopping ad of 30 to 90 seconds, with captions and on-screen text, and export three versions (one per hook).



Formats you will edit



Voiceover montage ads (B-roll cut to a voiceover)

Listicle ads (“5 reasons...” style)

POV and story-style ads

Product demos and side-by-side comparisons



What we are looking for



Proven experience making this type of ad: B-roll cut to a voiceover, for
, Instagram or TikTok

Experience editing problem-and-solution ads for footwear brands

You must be able to reverse engineer ads: break down an example video’s structure, pacing and editing style

You must be able to create an ad from an example video we have swiped and reverse engineered, following the exact same format and editing style

A strong understanding of hook rate, thumb-stop and what makes an ad convert

Strong at finding the right TikTok clips quickly, so every line of the script has a matching visual

Good instincts for hooks, pacing and keeping people watching

Clean captions and on-screen text

Proficient in CapCut

Able to use Google Flow to generate product clips when needed

Reliable, organised, and good at following a brief and our file naming

Comfortable making several ads a week and fast revisions



How to apply



Start your application with the words “TikTok B-roll” so we know you read this post.

Send 2 to 3 ads you edited that use TikTok or UGC B-roll with a voiceover (links please). Fully AI-generated videos will not be considered.

Tell us how you find and download TikTok clips for an ad.

Tell us your experience with Google Flow.

Your expected monthly salary and how many 60-second ads you can deliver per week.

s and other communication tasks

title: Government Contracts & Business Development Specialist
description:
Job Description

Northline Security Services is a Minnesota-based security company seeking an experienced, proactive, and results-driven Government Contracts & Business Development Specialist to help us identify, pursue, and secure new security service contracts.

This is NOT a traditional virtual assistant or basic lead generation position.

We need someone who can independently research opportunities, identify potential clients, navigate government procurement websites, prepare and submit contract proposals, and consistently conduct outreach to generate new business.

We are looking for someone who takes initiative rather than waiting to be assigned tasks.

Our goal is to build a consistent pipeline of new security contracts throughout Minnesota.



Key Responsibilities

1. Government Contract Research & Bidding

- Monitor federal, Minnesota state, county, city, school district, and public housing procurement websites.

- Identify open RFPs, RFQs, government bids, and security service contracting opportunities.

- Research upcoming contracts, expiring agreements, and potential rebidding opportunities.

- Review bid requirements and determine whether our company qualifies.

- Present qualified opportunities to management for approval.

- Once approved, independently prepare complete proposals using company documents stored in Google Drive.

- Complete required applications, forms, and supporting documentation.

- Submit proposals through government procurement portals after receiving final management approval.

- Track deadlines, submission statuses, and follow-up requirements.

- Maintain an organized database of government contracting opportunities.



2. Business Development & Client Outreach

This is one of the most important responsibilities of the position.

We need someone who actively searches for new business opportunities rather than simply generating contact lists.

Responsibilities include:

- Identify Minnesota businesses and organizations that may need security services.

- Research apartment complexes, property management companies, construction sites, commercial properties, schools, healthcare facilities, warehouses, and other potential clients.

- Identify decision-makers responsible for hiring security companies.

- Conduct personalized
 outreach and professional phone calls.

- Contact property managers, facility directors, business owners, and purchasing departments.

- Research upcoming projects, new developments, and organizations potentially looking to change security providers.

- Consistently follow up with potential clients.

- Schedule qualified appointments with interested organizations.

- Identify opportunities that competitors or other security companies may not be pursuing.

- Develop strategies to consistently generate new contracting opportunities.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply scrapes leads or sends hundreds of generic
s.

We need someone who can research organizations, identify real opportunities, establish contact with decision-makers, and help turn those opportunities into paying contracts.



3. CRM & Opportunity Management

- Maintain an organized pipeline of potential customers and government contracts.

- Track outreach activity, follow-ups, appointments, and bid deadlines.

- Monitor previously awarded contracts for upcoming renewals.

- Provide weekly reports showing opportunities identified, bids submitted, outreach completed, and meetings scheduled.

- Proactively recommend new industries, organizations, and opportunities to pursue.

Required Qualifications

- Previous experience with government contracting, procurement research, RFP submissions, or proposal writing.

- Experience conducting B2B business development and outreach.

- Familiarity with U.S. government procurement processes.

- Strong research and problem-solving abilities.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Experience preparing professional business proposals.

- Ability to independently identify and pursue business opportunities.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Experience with Google Workspace and CRM software.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with U.S.-based companies.

- Experience using SAM.gov or state government procurement portals.

- Previous experience submitting government contract bids.

- Experience in the security, staffing, construction, or facility management industries.

- Experience with cold calling,
 outreach, and appointment setting.

- Familiarity with Minnesota businesses and government agencies.



Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

Proactive: You independently find opportunities instead of waiting for instructions.

Resourceful: You know how to research unfamiliar websites, find decision-makers, and identify potential contracts.

Results-Oriented: Your goal is to help our company acquire new contracts, not simply complete assigned tasks.

Organized: You can manage multiple bids, deadlines, prospects, and follow-ups simultaneously.

Independent: You can take an approved opportunity from initial research through proposal preparation and submission.

Growth-Minded: You want to become a long-term part of a growing company.



Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by:

- Qualified government contracting opportunities identified.

- Approved proposals successfully prepared and submitted.

- Quality of potential clients identified.

- Consistency and effectiveness of outreach.

- Qualified appointments scheduled.

- Progress toward securing new security service contracts.

- Accuracy and organization of the contracting pipeline.



We value meaningful results over simply completing a high volume of tasks.



Schedule & Compensation

- Starting at approximately 20 hours per week.

- Flexible schedule with some availability during U.S. Central Time business hours.

- Initial 30-day evaluation period.

- Opportunity to transition into a full-time, long-term position based on performance.

- Compensation negotiable depending on experience and qualifications.



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

1. Your resume and relevant work experience.

2. Details of your experience researching or submitting U.S. government contracts.

3. Examples of procurement websites you have used.

4. Your experience with B2B outreach and generating business opportunities.

5. A brief explanation of how you would find security service contracts for a Minnesota-based company.

6. Your expected hourly rate.

7. Your weekly availability.

8.
 
 with your info



Start your application with "Northline Contracts" to confirm you have read the entire job description.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical assessment to demonstrate their ability to identify legitimate contracting opportunities and potential customers.

We are seeking someone who can take ownership of business development and become a valuable long-term member of Northline Security Services.

title: Amazon PPC Content Writer & LinkedIn Manager (US Amazon brands), daily posts
description:
About us

PPC Jumpstart is a small Amazon PPC agency based in Surrey, BC, Canada. Our clients are US brands selling on Amazon, mostly founders and owners doing $500K+ a year on Amazon. We manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display, and our job is simple to say: grow their sales while keeping ACOS within their target.



I'm Vadim, the founder. I post on LinkedIn to reach US brand owners. I want one person to own a daily LinkedIn post on my profile: short, sharp, useful Amazon PPC posts that a busy US owner reads in 30 seconds and thinks "I should check that in my account."



The goal is to make my name the one US brand owners think of for Amazon PPC. Reach matters, but every post has to be useful to a business owner, not just to other PPC people. No "comment X for the PDF" tricks.



What you'll do every day

- Write one LinkedIn post a day (Mon–Fri) in our house template: a short, contrarian hook, one-line paragraphs, one simple comparison, one named Amazon report or tool, and a clear "what this means for your sales / ACOS / margin."

- Design the graphic for each post (single 4:5 image, sometimes a short carousel) in our brand style: navy, gold and our logo. Templates are provided.

- Find post ideas in Amazon Ads updates, my weekly interview notes, client results I give you permission to use, and my Loom audit recordings.

- Score every draft against our checklist before you send it to me. Below the bar, rewrite it.

- Send drafts to me for approval. Nothing goes live without my approval.

- Get approved posts live at 8:00 AM Pacific Time (US), and add the first comment with my booking link right after.

- Seven days after each post, open the post analytics and log where viewers came from (country/city) in our tracking sheet.

- Send a short Monday report: what went out, what scored well, which posts reached US viewers.



Must-haves

- Amazon Ads console fluency. You have worked inside Amazon Ads (as a PPC specialist, VA or account manager). You know Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display, and you can read a search term report without help.

- You understand ACOS vs TACoS and can explain to a business owner why the lowest ACOS isn't always the best result.

- Strong US-business English. Short sentences, plain words, no filler. You can write for a US founder, not for other PPC specialists.

- Canva or Figma. You can follow a brand template exactly: colours, logo, spacing.

- LinkedIn native. You know how LinkedIn posts, carousels (PDF), first comments, scheduling and post analytics work.

- Reliable during US Pacific mornings. Posts go live at 8:00 AM PT, every weekday.

- Comfortable taking direct edits and rewriting fast.



Nice-to-haves

- You've ghostwritten LinkedIn posts for a founder or agency.

- Familiar with Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, Business Reports, placement reports, Manage Your Experiments.

- You follow Amazon seller news and can explain an Amazon change in 3 lines.

- Basic video editing (short captioned clips).

- Google Sheets for simple logs.



Hours

- Must overlap with US Pacific mornings. Posts go live at 8:00 AM PT Mon–Fri.

- Philippines time: 8:00 AM PT = 11:00 PM PHT until Nov 1, 2026, then 12:00 AM (midnight) PHT after US clocks change (Nov 1 to March).

- Flexible part-time schedule. Time is tracked in Time Doctor.

- About 15–20 hrs/week to start.



Pay

$7–11 USD per hour, depending on skill and trial results. Hours tracked in Time Doctor.



Paid trial

Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial, about 3 hours of work at your hourly rate, 48 hours to send it back. You'll write 3 posts from raw notes we give you and design 1 graphic. We'll pay for the trial whether or not we hire you.



How to apply

1. Put MARGIN FIRST as the first line of your application. Applications without it won't be read.

2. Answer in your own words, no AI (we'll know):

   - In 3 sentences, explain to a US brand owner why a low ACOS can hurt their sales.

   - What is the difference between ACOS and TACoS, and which one would you show an owner first? Why?

   - Which Amazon Ads reports have you used, and for what?

3. Send 2–3 LinkedIn posts or graphics you've written or designed (links or images).

4. Tell us your shift availability in Philippine time.

5. Optional: a 2-minute Loom or video introducing yourself in English.

title: Customer relations manager
description:
HEAT Nutrition

Customer Success & Growth Coordinator (Remote Virtual Assistant)

Position: Customer Success & Growth Coordinator

Department: Customer Relations & Sales

Location: Remote

Reports To: Business Owner / Management

Pay: $4/hour with up to $1,000/month in additional bonuses



Position Overview

HEAT Nutrition is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and results-driven Customer Success & Growth Coordinator to manage customer relationships, oversee customer accounts, and drive consistent growth in our weekly meal prep business.



This position is responsible for delivering a high-touch, concierge-style customer experience while ensuring existing customers continue ordering, inactive customers are reactivated, and prospective customers are consistently followed up with and converted.



The primary objective is simple: Increase weekly meal orders, grow recurring subscriptions, and maximize customer retention.



Key Responsibilities



1. Customer Account Management & Retention

* Manage existing customer accounts and maintain accurate customer information.

* Build relationships with recurring weekly meal prep customers through personalized SMS,
, and other digital communication.

* Proactively contact customers who have stopped ordering.

* Encourage existing customers to maintain consistent weekly orders.

* Identify customers who may benefit from meal subscription plans.

* Resolve customer concerns to maintain a premium customer experience.



2. Shopify Management

* Monitor and manage incoming customer orders.

* Assist customers with order questions, subscription modifications, and account issues.

* Maintain accurate customer records and order information.

* Identify repeat purchasers and potential subscription customers.

* Track weekly order volume and meal counts.

* Support customer subscription management and retention.



3. GoHighLevel CRM & Pipeline Management

* Manage and organize prospect and customer pipelines.

* Ensure customer profiles, notes, tags, and opportunities remain updated.

* Track leads throughout the customer acquisition process.

* Execute follow-up sequences through SMS,
, and other approved communication channels.

* Identify stalled opportunities and proactively reengage prospects.

* Maintain accurate CRM records and follow-up tasks.



4. Prospecting & Outbound Customer Acquisition

* Conduct outbound prospecting to generate new meal prep customers.

* Contact prospective customers through approved outreach channels.

* Follow up with individuals who previously expressed interest in HEAT Nutrition.

* Convert qualified prospects into first-time meal prep customers.

* Promote introductory meal offers and recurring subscriptions.

* Maintain consistent daily outreach activity.



5. Subscription Growth & Customer Reactivation

* Convert one-time purchasers into repeat customers.

* Introduce qualified customers to weekly subscription options.

* Follow up with canceled, paused, or inactive customers.

* Identify reasons for customer cancellations and ordering inactivity.

* Implement approved customer reactivation campaigns.

* Work toward continuously increasing active subscriptions and weekly meal counts.



6. Customer Service & Concierge Experience

* Respond professionally and promptly to customer questions.

* Provide personalized assistance through digital communication.

* Help customers understand ordering deadlines, delivery procedures, and subscription benefits.

* Coordinate with internal operations when issues arise.

* Ensure every customer receives a convenient, positive, and consistent experience.



7. Reporting & Performance Tracking



* Track new customers acquired each week.

* Monitor returning and inactive customers.

* Report active subscription totals and subscription changes.

* Track weekly meal counts and order volume.

* Maintain outreach and follow-up activity records.

* Submit weekly performance summaries identifying progress, opportunities, and customer retention concerns.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated using measurable results:



* Weekly Meal Count: Consistent growth in total meals ordered.

* New Customer Acquisition: Number of new paying customers generated.

* Subscription Growth: Net increase in active weekly meal subscriptions.

* Customer Retention: Percentage of customers continuing to place orders.

* Customer Reactivation: Number of inactive customers successfully brought back.

* Lead Conversion: Percentage of qualified prospects converted into paying customers.

* Response Time: Timely responses to customer inquiries.

* CRM Accuracy: Consistent and accurate customer records, pipeline updates, and follow-up tracking.



Qualifications



* Experience in virtual assistance, customer success, customer service, or sales support.

* Experience with Shopify and GoHighLevel is strongly preferred.

* Strong written English communication skills.

* Comfortable communicating with customers through SMS,
, and social media messaging.

* Experience managing CRM pipelines and customer follow-up campaigns.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-motivated.

* Comfortable conducting cold outreach and following up with prospective customers.

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of measurable performance goals.

* A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and business growth.



What Success Looks Like



The ideal candidate takes ownership of our customer relationships and growth opportunities.



They don’t simply wait for customers to reach out. They proactively identify opportunities to acquire new customers, bring back inactive customers, encourage repeat orders, and convert existing customers into recurring subscribers.



The ultimate goal is to help HEAT Nutrition build a loyal, growing customer base that generates predictable, recurring weekly revenue.



Our Mission: To provide a simple, convenient, and life-changing experience through fresh, high-protein meals that make healthy eating easier.

title: Ecommerce Product Research & Creative Sourcing VA
description:
We are a growing US-based ecommerce company looking for a reliable, full-time Product Research and Creative Sourcing Virtual Assistant.



This role supports our internal product-research and launch workflow. You will be trained on our process, SOPs, tools, and documentation standards. However, we are looking for someone who can work independently, think critically, identify bottlenecks, and suggest practical ways to make the workflow faster and more efficient.



Your role will involve researching potential ecommerce products, reviewing market data and creative examples, checking supplier and profitability information, preparing simple offers, organizing video references for our creative team, setting up products in Shopify, and documenting findings in Google Sheets.



What You’ll Do



- Research potential ecommerce products using internal research tools and market-analysis platforms

- Identify products that meet our requirements based on demand, competition, pricing, available creative angles, and overall potential

- Find suitable suppliers and comparable products through Alibaba and other approved sources

- Check product cost, shipping cost, selling price, and estimated gross margin to determine whether a product is viable

- Create simple offer ideas, such as pricing, bundles, discounts, or other purchase incentives

- Identify direct-response-focused creative examples, hooks, angles, and video concepts that could work for a product

- Source and organize relevant publicly available video references for our video editor

- Add product details, supplier information, research notes, offer ideas, and creative references into our documents and workflows

- Create products in Shopify using our templates and process

- Keep product research and launch information organized and accurate in Google Sheets

- Follow our SOPs while identifying missing steps, bottlenecks, or inefficiencies in the workflow

- Suggest practical process improvements when you see a way to make research, documentation, or handoffs more efficient



Performance Expectations



- The initial target is to complete research and documentation for 3 products per day using our process

- As you become comfortable with the workflow, the target is expected to scale to 5 products per day

- Quality, accuracy, organization, and sound judgment are important. We value thoughtful research, not rushed or incomplete work.



Schedule and Availability



- This is a full-time position: 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday

- You must be online and working sometime between 8:00 AM–12:00 PM PST

- Reliable attendance and consistent availability during these hours are required



What We’re Looking For



- Previous ecommerce product-research experience is required

- Understanding of gross margin, product cost, selling price, shipping cost, and general profit margins

- Experience using product-research tools, ad libraries, competitor-research tools, or similar platforms

- Ability to identify direct-response-focused creative, effective video hooks, product angles, and marketing concepts

- Familiarity with Alibaba or supplier research

- Experience with Shopify product setup is preferred

- Comfortable using Google Sheets and keeping detailed information organized

- Strong written English and the ability to understand instructions, product information, and written feedback

- Detail-oriented and able to accurately compare pricing, supplier information, product costs, and margins

- Able to follow SOPs while also thinking independently

- Proactive about identifying bottlenecks and recommending sensible improvements

- Dependable internet connection and a reliable computer

- Able to work independently while staying responsive to the manager and team



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. A summary of your ecommerce product-research experience

3. The product-research, ad-research, or competitor-research tools you have used

4. A brief explanation of how you determine whether a product has enough gross margin to test

5. Your current availability in US Eastern Time

6. A link or screenshot showing relevant past work, such as product research, a product sheet, a Shopify listing, or a similar project, if available



Please use the subject line: Ecommerce Product Research VA



We are looking for an organized, proactive team member who is interested in growing with a fast-moving ecommerce company.

### About My Business



I'm a spiritual life coach and transformational parenting mentor based in Sedona, Arizona.



After nearly 20 years supporting families as an educator and 15 years of my own spiritual healing and inner work, I realized something important: knowing what to do doesn't always mean we can do it when we're emotionally triggered.



Now I help conscious mothers who have read parenting books, done personal development work, and tried different approaches but still find themselves yelling, reacting, and feeling guilty afterward.



My work helps mothers break generational patterns, heal their own emotional wounds, and raise children who feel safe, confident, and free to be who they truly are.



Website: [
](
)



### What I'm Looking For



I'm looking for an experienced, reliable appointment setter who can help me connect with mothers who would benefit from my coaching.



Your primary responsibility is to **find new potential clients, start genuine conversations, build relationships, follow up, and book qualified consultations.**



This is not simply an administrative or scheduling position.



I'm not interested in mass messaging, aggressive sales tactics, or generic copy-and-paste outreach. My work is personal, and I want someone who can represent it with care and authenticity.



### Responsibilities

, Instagram, Threads, and relevant online communities.

- Provide a simple daily activity report.

- Previous experience in social media outreach, lead generation, or appointment setting.

- Experience working with coaches, personal development businesses, or wellness professionals is preferred.

- Strong written English and natural communication skills.

- Ability to independently find new potential clients, even without a large existing audience.

- Strong understanding of motherhood, conscious parenting, and the emotional challenges mothers experience.

- Ability to communicate with mothers in a warm, empathetic, and authentic way.

- Personal experience with motherhood or working closely with mothers is a plus.

- Comfortable discussing sensitive topics such as parenting struggles, emotional triggers, and generational patterns.

- Comfortable building relationships rather than using aggressive sales tactics.

- Organized, reliable, and consistent with follow-ups.

- Willingness to understand my coaching approach and ideal clients.



### Hours and Compensation



- Approximately 5 hours per week initially.

- Starting pay: $5/hour.

- Opportunity to increase hours as the business grows.

- Short paid trial period before a longer-term commitment.



### How to Apply



Please begin your application with the word **SEDONA** so I know you've read the entire post.

I'm looking for someone who values genuine human connection, takes initiative, and wants to grow with a purpose-driven coaching business.



Thank you!



Misun

Founder, Sedona Coach

title: Performance Video Editor – Meta Ads
description:
Performance Video Editor – Meta Ads

LERAVA is looking for a specialized Performance Video Editor for Meta Ads.



We are not looking for a traditional video editor who simply puts together visually appealing footage. We are looking for someone who understands how direct-response and performance creatives for
 and Instagram are structured and who can quickly produce high-performing videos based on scripts, competitor ads, and our Creative Strategy.

Our goal is to maintain a continuous output of new creatives that we can test on Meta and continuously improve based on actual performance data.

Your Responsibilities

You will be responsible for the entire video editing process — from the finished script to a Meta Ad that is ready to upload.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Researching and downloading relevant scripts and creative insights from TrendTrack

• Analyzing the competitors we provide and their successful video ads

• Executing our Creative Strategy and video briefs

• Selecting suitable B-roll footage from our Shade library

• Using Shade’s AI search to quickly find relevant scenes for individual parts of the script

• Downloading and professionally editing the required B-roll footage

• Creating voiceovers using ElevenLabs

• Synchronizing voiceovers, B-roll, text, music, and other creative elements

• Creating attention-grabbing hooks

• Adding subtitles and on-screen text

• Optimizing videos according to Meta Ads requirements and best practices

• Creating different hooks, angles, and creative variations for testing

• Localizing creatives for different countries and languages

• Performing quality control before publication

• Uploading finished creatives to Trybe

Media buying and campaign management are handled internally by our team.

Languages

Our creatives are currently produced in the following languages:

German, Italian, French, Spanish, Dutch, and Polish.

You do not need to speak all of these languages fluently.

Scripts and voiceovers will either be provided or created using our tools. However, it is essential that you work very carefully with the different language versions, voiceovers, subtitles, and on-screen text.

Our Workflow

You will receive access to all required tools and platforms:

TrendTrack → Script / Inspiration → Shade → B-Roll → ElevenLabs → Voiceover → Video Editing → Subtitles & Localization → Trybe → Media Buying

We will also provide an initial briefing covering:

• Our products and brands

• Our target audiences

• Our main competitors

• Successful creative angles

• Our preferred editing style

• Our previous best-performing creatives

After the onboarding phase, we expect you to be able to work as independently as possible.

Once per week, you will receive a performance briefing from our team. We will show you which creatives, hooks, angles, and concepts performed particularly well or poorly.

These insights should directly influence the following week’s creative production.

Produce → Test → Analyze → Iterate → Scale

Expected Output

We are looking for someone who can achieve a high creative production velocity.

As an initial target and weekly quota, we expect approximately a minimum of 8 fully edited video ads per language per week. Higher output is welcome if quality can be maintained.

For example, our weekly production may include:

• 3–5 new creative concepts

• Multiple hooks and creative variations

• Further iterations of winning creatives

• Localization of successful creatives across our six markets

If you can use our workflow to produce high-quality creatives faster, a higher output is explicitly encouraged.

However, one principle is very important to us:

Quality and performance are more important than quantity alone.

What We Expect From You

You should already have experience with Performance Video Editing for Meta Ads.

We particularly value:

• Experience creating
 and Instagram Ads

• A strong understanding of direct-response creatives

• An excellent sense for hooks and the first 1–3 seconds of a video

• Fast and dynamic editing

• Experience with UGC, B-roll, and voiceover-based ads

• A strong understanding of pacing, pattern interrupts, and viewer retention

• Experience with subtitles and on-screen text

• The ability to independently turn a script into a compelling, performance-focused video

• The ability to analyze existing winning ads and develop new variations from them

• Strong attention to detail when working with multiple languages

• High production speed

• A reliable, organized, and independent working style

Experience with AI-based creative workflows is a major plus.

Collaboration

Our internal communication takes place via Slack.

Working hours and projects are tracked through Hubstaff.

Payment is made weekly via Wise.

You will receive regular feedback from our Performance/Marketing Team and will be able to see which of your creatives actually perform well.

We are specifically looking for a long-term collaboration.

Application

Please send us:

1. A short introduction about yourself and your previous experience with Performance Video Editing.

2. Examples of Meta Ads that you personally edited.

3. If possible, examples of direct-response, UGC, or B-roll-based ads.

4. The editing software you primarily use.

5. How many comparable video ads you can realistically produce per week.

6. How many hours per week you are available.

7. Your hourly rate in USD or EUR.

8. Your time zone and country.

9. Your earliest possible start date.

Important: Please primarily send us examples of performance ads rather than traditional image, branding, or cinematic videos.

We are looking for an editor who wants to become a long-term part of our creative process and work with us to continuously produce better-performing ads based on real Meta performance data.

title: Amazon FBA Product Research & Supplier Sourcing VA — Long-Term Opportunity
description:
# Amazon FBA Product Research & Supplier Sourcing VA — Long-Term Opportunity



**Company:** Africa Unite Distribution  

**Position:** Amazon FBA Product Research & Supplier Sourcing Virtual Assistant  

**Employment Type:** Part-time to start, with potential for long-term growth  

**Experience Required:** 2+ years of Amazon product research experience preferred



## About Africa Unite



Africa Unite is a growing e-commerce business focused on bringing authentic African products to customers in the United States through Amazon FBA.



Our product categories include African foods, agricultural products, natural beauty products, and other culturally relevant products with strong market potential.



Our long-term vision is to build a scalable brand that connects African producers and manufacturers with the American market. We are looking for a reliable, analytical, and resourceful VA who can help us discover profitable opportunities and build a dependable supplier network.



## Your Primary Responsibilities



### 1. Amazon FBA Product Research



Your primary responsibility is to identify **10–20 qualified product leads per week** that meet our research criteria.



You will research products based on:



- Customer demand, sales volume, and sales trends.

- Competition, listing quality, review counts, and barriers to entry.

- Selling price, estimated FBA fees, shipping costs, and other relevant expenses.

- Estimated net profit, profit margin, ROI, and break-even advertising costs.

- Seasonality, price history, and market stability.

- Amazon restrictions, category approval, brand restrictions, and product eligibility.

- Potential risks involving expiration dates, food safety, labeling, documentation, and import requirements.



You must be able to distinguish genuinely attractive opportunities from products that look profitable but have excessive competition, unreliable demand, or significant compliance barriers.



### 2. Product Research Tools



You must be comfortable using:



- **Keepa:** Sales rank history, price history, Buy Box trends, competition, and demand stability.

- **SellerAmp SAS:** Profit calculations, estimated sales, eligibility checks, competition analysis, and sourcing decisions.

- Amazon Seller Central and Amazon search results.

- Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel for tracking and reporting.

- Additional research tools when they improve the accuracy of your findings.



You must know how to interpret the data rather than simply collect screenshots or copy numbers from software.



### 3. Our Product Sourcing Strategy



Our research will follow two primary tracks:



**70% — African products for private label**



Find African-origin products that could be developed under the Africa Unite brand, especially products with identifiable demand and opportunities to differentiate our offering.



Examples include:



- Tiger nuts and other African agricultural products.

- Sobolo ingredients and dried hibiscus products.

- Shea butter and natural beauty ingredients.

- Prekese, waakye leaves, alligator pepper, and other African spices and botanicals.

- Fufu ingredients and other African pantry staples.

- Other promising African food, agricultural, and personal-care products.



These are examples, not a restriction on your research. You should actively identify new opportunities beyond our current catalog.



**30% — Established African products and brands**



Research recognizable African products that already have demand in the United States and may offer reliable, repeatable sales opportunities.



For these products, investigate brand authorization requirements, invoices, wholesale pricing, competition, Amazon selling eligibility, and the potential for sustainable margins.



**Important:** We prioritize products that can be sourced consistently, sold compliantly, and reordered profitably. Do not recommend a product simply because it is African or has a high selling price.



### 4. Supplier Sourcing & Verification



Once a promising product is identified, research suppliers and help us determine the best sourcing option.



Responsibilities include:



- Finding manufacturers, wholesalers, farms, cooperatives, and exporters.

- Prioritizing reliable suppliers in Ghana and other African countries where appropriate.

- Comparing local US wholesalers against direct international sourcing.

- Requesting quotations, minimum order quantities (MOQs), samples, lead times, and payment terms.

- Comparing unit costs, packaging costs, shipping, customs duties, and other landed costs.

- Identifying suppliers that offer consistent quality and repeatable inventory.

- Checking supplier credibility, business documentation, references, and export capabilities.

- Determining whether suppliers can provide the documentation needed for Amazon and applicable US import requirements.

- Organizing supplier communications and maintaining a database of qualified contacts.



For international suppliers, you should be comfortable communicating professionally across time zones and following up persistently.



You will research and recommend suppliers. **All supplier approvals, purchases, and financial commitments must be authorized by the business owner.**



### 5. Product Eligibility, Compliance & Ungating Research



Before recommending a product, investigate whether Africa Unite can realistically sell it on Amazon.



This includes:



- Checking category, brand, and ASIN-level restrictions where applicable.

- Identifying potential approval or ungating requirements.

- Researching acceptable invoices, supplier qualifications, and documentation.

- Flagging products that may require FDA-related, food safety, cosmetics, labeling, or import compliance review.

- Identifying potential intellectual property, trademark, authenticity, or restricted-product risks.



Do not assume a product is ungateable merely because another seller offers it. Clearly distinguish verified eligibility from requirements that still need confirmation in Seller Central or with the relevant authority.



### 6. Product Listings & Growth Support



As needed, assist with:



- Competitor listing analysis and keyword research.

- Product title, bullet point, and listing improvement suggestions.

- Identifying listing weaknesses and opportunities for differentiation.

- Reviewing customer feedback and recurring complaints.

- Tracking product performance, inventory, and competitor changes.

- Providing research that supports pricing and advertising decisions.



Product research and sourcing will remain your primary responsibilities.



## Weekly Deliverables



You are expected to deliver **10–20 qualified product leads per week**, not simply a list of product ideas.



Each lead must include:



1. Product name and proposed Amazon marketplace.

2. Existing Amazon listing or relevant competitor examples.

3. Estimated monthly sales and supporting demand evidence.

4. Current selling price and competition analysis.

5. Keepa and SellerAmp findings, where applicable.

6. Estimated product cost, FBA fees, landed cost, and other material expenses.

7. Estimated net profit per unit, profit margin, ROI, and break-even considerations.

8. Selling restrictions, ungating requirements, and compliance concerns.

9. At least one potential supplier, including contact information and pricing when available.

10. Recommended next step and a brief explanation of why the product is worth considering.



Maintain an organized Google Sheet with source links, calculations, research dates, supplier details, and a clear status for every lead.



Prioritize quality and accuracy over inflated lead counts. Clearly flag estimates, assumptions, and missing information.



## Required Qualifications



- At least 2 years of hands-on Amazon product research experience preferred.

- Practical knowledge of Amazon FBA, with an understanding of FBM where relevant.

- Strong working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp SAS.

- Ability to calculate landed costs, FBA fees, net profit, ROI, and margins.

- Experience sourcing products and communicating with suppliers.

- Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written English and professional communication.

- Proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel.

- High attention to detail and the ability to meet weekly deadlines.

- Comfortable working independently and presenting evidence to support recommendations.



Experience with African products, international trade, food or beauty products, private-label sourcing, and US import requirements is a significant advantage.



## What We Value



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, thinks like a business operator, and understands that a product must be profitable, sellable, and reliably sourced to be a good opportunity.



We value initiative, honesty, data-driven decisions, clear communication, and long-term thinking.



We do not want generic product lists, copied research, unrealistic profit estimates, or suppliers that have not been properly evaluated.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction describing your Amazon FBA product research and sourcing experience.

2. The tools you have used, specifically Keepa and SellerAmp SAS, and how you use them to evaluate products.

3. An example of a product you researched, including its selling price, estimated sales, costs, net profit, ROI, competition, and sourcing approach. Please remove any confidential client information.

4. An example of a supplier you identified or a product you helped source, including the process you used to evaluate the supplier.

5. Your expected monthly compensation and weekly availability.

6. Confirm whether you can consistently research and submit 10–20 qualified product leads per week.



**Please begin your application with the words “AFRICA UNITE” so we know you have read the full posting.**



We are looking for a dependable long-term partner who can help Africa Unite discover the right products, establish reliable sourcing relationships, and grow a sustainable Amazon business.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
We're  an Australian web and branding agency specialising in premium websites and digital marketing for architects, builders, and property businesses.



We're looking for an experienced, hands-on SEO Specialist with strong Webflow experience to take ownership of the day-to-day execution of our clients' SEO campaigns.



This is not an entry-level position. We need someone who already has a strong understanding of SEO, knows how to optimise websites effectively, and can confidently implement improvements without constant guidance.



Our SEO strategy, keyword research, and campaign direction will be handled by our strategist. Your responsibility is to take that strategy and execute it to a high standard.



What You'll Be Doing:



– On-page SEO: Optimising titles, meta descriptions, headings, content, images, URLs, and page structure.



– Technical SEO: Identifying and resolving indexing issues, crawl errors, broken links, redirects, canonical tags, and other technical problems.



– Webflow SEO: Making SEO improvements directly inside Webflow, including CMS collections, page structures, redirects, and technical settings.



– Internal linking: Identifying and implementing strategic internal linking opportunities across websites.



– Google Business Profile: Optimising listings, services, categories, posts, and local SEO signals.



– Content optimisation: Publishing and optimising service pages, landing pages, and blog articles.



– SEO reporting: Monitoring keyword rankings, organic traffic, leads, and overall campaign performance.



– Conversion optimisation: Identifying opportunities to improve website enquiries, landing pages, and calls to action.



What We're Looking For:



– 3+ years of proven, hands-on SEO experience, preferably with agencies or service-based businesses.



– Webflow experience is required. You must be confident working inside the Webflow Designer and CMS, not just editing basic content.



– Advanced understanding of on-page SEO, technical SEO, internal linking, and local SEO.



– Demonstrated experience improving organic keyword rankings and traffic through SEO implementation.



– Strong knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, Google Business Profile, and tools such as Ahrefs or SEMrush.



– Ability to independently audit website pages, identify SEO issues, and implement the necessary fixes.



– Understanding of local SEO and lead generation for service-based businesses.



– Excellent attention to detail, organisation, and communication.



– Ability to work independently, take initiative, and consistently deliver high-quality work.



What Success Looks Like:



You'll be provided with the overall SEO strategy, target keywords, and campaign priorities.



From there, we expect you to confidently handle the execution, identify additional opportunities, resolve issues, and ensure that every website is properly optimised.



We don't want someone who simply follows a checklist. We want someone who understands why SEO changes matter, can make informed decisions, and takes ownership of their work.



Our focus is on real results: improved keyword rankings, qualified organic traffic, and more enquiries for our clients.



Role Details



– Location: Philippines (Remote)



– Hours: Initially 15–20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time role.



– Schedule: Flexible hours between 9am to 6pm Brisbane time



– Long-term opportunity as our SEO client portfolio grows.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



SEO experience: Share an SEO campaign where you personally implemented changes that improved rankings or organic traffic. What did you do, and what were the results?



Webflow experience: How long have you worked with Webflow, and what SEO-related tasks have you personally implemented within it? Please share examples of Webflow websites you've worked on.



Technical SEO: If a service page is indexed but struggling to rank for its target keyword, how would you investigate and improve it?



Availability: How many hours per week can you work, and what is your expected hourly rate in AUD?



Important: Applications without demonstrated SEO experience and practical Webflow experience will not be considered.



Please include examples of websites you've personally optimised and explain your involvement.

description:
Industry: Airbnb & Post-Construction Cleaning

Location: Remote

About Us



MyCleanBnb is a professional cleaning company covering Gold Coast, Brisbane and Tweed in Australia. Currently serving short-term rentals and expanding into post-construction cleaning. We’ve built a solid foundation with tools like Operto Teams and QuickBooks and are now ready to take our systems to the next level with automation and streamlined digital workflows.



Your Mission



We’re hiring a Remote Digital Solutions Specialist to help us optimise and automate multiple business processes using cloud-based tools and lightweight, serverless integrations. You’ll be responsible for designing and implementing automation that connects tools we already use, replaces clunky spreadsheets, and supports sales, operations, onboarding, training, and team monitoring.



What You’ll Work On



1. Quoting Automation & Sales Follow-Up System

• Replace the manual Google Sheet quote calculator with a dynamic, form-driven solution.

• Use Google Forms + Apps Script to automate pricing estimates and generate client-ready quotes.

• Create lightweight sales pipeline tracking tools to follow up and convert quotes into jobs.

• Trigger updates to Operto Teams, QuickBooks, and property/job rate spreadsheets when quotes are accepted.

 

2. Cleaner Onboarding & SOP Platform

• Migrate SOPs into Whale, Trainual (or any other recommended tool) and help structure the training modules.

• Design a tech-based onboarding experience with tracking and automated assignments for new team members.

• Automate status updates based on SOP completion.



3. Quality Assurance Reporting & Monitoring Dashboards

• Connect and simplify existing QA spreadsheets (from Google Forms, WhatsApp images, client feedback).

• Build dashboards to track service failures, team trends, and key cleaning KPIs.

• Automate alerts or reports for internal decision-making.



4. Spreadsheet Process Consolidation & Integration

• Review and clean up multiple existing Google Sheets (e.g. cleaner rates, cleaner availability, categorisation).

• Link them with Google Apps Script and automate updates where possible.

• Provide dashboards or reporting tools to make data more actionable.



5. Operto Teams & QuickBooks Usage Optimisation

• Audit current workflows in Operto Teams (scheduling, tasks) and QuickBooks (invoicing, accounting).

• Recommend better usage of features and ensure integration is seamless.

• Automate manual data entries between quoting, task scheduling, and invoicing.



6. Virtual Assistant Monitoring

• Implement WorkTime, Controlio (or any other recommended tool) to ensure team members are active during working hours.

• Set up dashboards or alerts to flag inactivity or productivity concerns.



7. Basic Website Updates

• Add a new page for the post-construction cleaning service to the company website.

• Edit layout, text, or visuals as needed (basic CMS knowledge required).



Tools You’ll Be Using

Automation & Logic: Google Apps Script, Google Cloud Functions, AWS Lambda (serverless), Zapier, Make

Forms & Quoting: Google Forms, Sheets

Scheduling: Operto Teams

Accounting: QuickBooks

SOP & Onboarding: Whale, Trainual

Monitoring: WorkTime, Controlio

Dashboards: Google Data Studio, Airtable

Website: WordPress / Webflow / Wix (basic updates only)



Ideal Candidate

• Experience with Google Apps Script, serverless automation, and process mapping

• Strong understanding of tools like Zapier, Make, and cloud-based solutions

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
I'm hiring one full-time editor. This is for one person, not an agency or a team.



The job



Edit short-form video, mostly 9:16 talking head for Instagram Reels, plus some Meta ads.

Footage comes from cameras and log profiles (S-Log3, D-Log M, C-Log). You colourgrade it.

Every client has a style file. Read it before you cut. It holds their captions, grade style, music and every note they've ever given, so you know exactly what is expected.

3-4 videos submitted to QA a day, Monday to Friday.

Fixes and revisions come first. They're due by the end of your next working day and don't count toward the 4.

You work with myself and our project manager on WhatsApp. The project manager handles every client message. You never reply to clients directly.

Footage and review run through Timeliner.io.

The standard

Every video is checked against ten points. All ten pass or it doesn't go out. You score it first, then the project manager, then a final AI check.



Audio clear, no clipping

No black frames or glitches

Correct 9:16

Captions spelled correctly

No dead air in the first 1.5 seconds

Filler and long pauses trimmed

Clean cuts, pacing holds to the end

Captions burned in, sentence case, three words a line, below the chin

Grade true to skin with a light saturation push

Colour, logo and music correct for that client

What you need



2+ years editing short-form for social, including vertical talking head you cut yourself OR proof that you are good at editing

DaVinci Resolve

A computer that handles 4K footage

At least 50 Mbps internet and a backup plan for brownouts

English good enough to read a style file and reply to written notes clearly

What you get



PHP $57000 a month retainer (minimum depending on experience), paid monthly via Wise

The same clients long term, so you learn their style instead of starting fresh every week

Steady volume. No chasing gigs.

Monday to Friday, day shift Philippine time. Brisbane is 2 hours ahead, so most of your day overlaps ours.

The first month is a trial and you're paid in full either way.



How to apply

Put CADENCE in your subject line. Applications without it don't get read.



Send:



A link to 3 to 5 vertical talking-head edits you cut yourself

How many videos like that you can finish to a high standard in a day

A screenshot of your internet speed test

Your answer to this: a client says the captions are too slow. You've already sent 3 videos with the same captions. What do you do?

Briefly explain how to do a Rec709 conversion on DaVinci

Shortlisted editors do a paid test: one real clip with a style file, scored on the same ten checks, then one round of notes. PH $500.



Talk soon!



Cheers,

Dylan

description:
We’re looking for a Player Experience (PX)  Support Associate to join our team and provide thoughtful, accurate, and efficient support to our players.



You’ll help players resolve account, gameplay, purchase, and technical issues while also identifying bugs, recurring pain points, and opportunities to improve the overall player experience.



We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, communicates clearly, and genuinely enjoys games. Our games and processes continue to evolve, so being comfortable learning new systems and adapting to change is important.



What You’ll Do



- Respond to player questions and support requests through our helpdesk.

- Investigate account, gameplay, purchase, and technical issues and work toward appropriate resolutions.

- Identify, document, and escalate suspected bugs or technical issues with clear and useful information for the appropriate teams.

- Recognize recurring player issues and surface trends, feedback, and opportunities for improvement.

- Use internal tools, admin panels, and other systems to investigate player concerns.

- Review player-reported content and take appropriate action when required.

- Work with the team to improve macros, FAQs, internal documentation, and support workflows to make sure everything is up to date.

- Provide feedback and suggestions to help improve support processes and the overall player experience.

- Stay up to date with changes to our games, policies, tools, and support procedures.



What We’re Looking For



- 2+ years of experience in customer support, player support, or a similar role. Written chat or ticket-based support experience is strongly preferred.

- A college degree.

- Experience using a helpdesk platform is a plus, particularly Intercom.

- Excellent written English, with native or near-native fluency, and the ability to communicate clearly, naturally, and professionally.

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate an issue before reaching a conclusion.

- Good judgment and attention to detail when handling unusual or ambiguous player concerns.

- Comfort working with technical systems such as helpdesks, CRMs, admin panels, moderation tools, or similar platforms.

- Ability to learn new tools and adapt to changing processes and workflows.

- A genuine interest in and passion for games.

- Ability to work independently and communicate effectively in a fully remote environment.

- Availability to work assigned shifts, including day or night shifts as required.

- Reliable high-speed internet, electricity, and a suitable workstation.



Nice to Have



- Previous experience supporting a mobile, online, or live-service game or application.

- Experience with Intercom or similar helpdesk software.

- Experience with bug reporting, reproduction steps, or working with QA or development teams.

- Experience with content moderation or player safety workflows.

----------------------------------
