- Troubleshooting: Identify and fix spreadsheet errors, missing data, and Supermetrics connection issues before or during meetings.

- Coach Support: Organise client files, update roadmaps, track tasks, and assist coaches with daily administrative work.

- Quality Control: Spot data inconsistencies, investigate problems, and ensure reports are reliable.

What We're Looking For

- A numbers person! Someone who enjoys working with figures, percentages, and business data.

- Confident using Google Sheets or Excel, including formulas.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Proactive, reliable, and able to work independently.

- Comfortable learning new software and technical processes.

Bonus Skills (Not Required): Experience with Supermetrics, Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics, or Basecamp.



-----------------------------------------------------------------

What We Offer



From Day One:

- Competitive salary based on experience and skills.

- Paid time off and paid holidays.

- Permanent work-from-home opportunity.

- Full training and ongoing support.

- Career growth opportunities within a growing UK-based company.

Additional Benefits After Probation:

- Bonus salary.

- Additional paid sick leave and holiday leave.

- Paid birthday leave.

- Health insurance.



--------------------------



How to Apply



Please send your CV, expected monthly salary, and a short introduction explaining your experience with spreadsheets, numbers, and administrative support.



In your application, answer these two questions:

1. How confident are you with Google Sheets or Excel (1–10), and which formulas have you used?

2. If a client's sales report suddenly shows zero revenue when you know they've made sales, how would you investigate the issue?



We're looking for someone who doesn't just spot problems but takes the initiative to solve them.



If you love numbers, enjoy solving problems, and want to grow with a supportive team, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Marketing Lead / Lead Generation Manager – Painting Company (Meta + Google Ads)
description:
We're Smooth Finish Painting LLC, a residential and commercial painting company in Northwest Indiana (Crown Point, Schererville and Valparaiso area). We're growing, and we want a full-time marketing person whose main job is bringing in quality leads. We don't need someone who only posts pretty pictures. We need someone who knows where every lead came from, what it cost, and whether it turned into a paying job.



Right now an outside ad agency runs our ads, and we plan to bring that work in-house with you. You'll own our marketing from the first click to the closed job, and you'll report directly to the owner.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Lead capture and routing

- Watch every lead channel daily:
/Instagram, Google Ads, Google Business Profile, our website form, and phone/SMS

- Make sure every lead is captured, tagged by source, and sent to the right person fast so nothing slips through



Paid ads

- Set up, manage, optimize and report on Meta 
/Instagram) Ads and Google Ads campaigns

- Test offers, audiences, creatives and landing pages to lower cost per lead and raise lead quality

- Take over the campaigns our current agency runs



Local presence

- Manage and improve our Google Business Profile (posts, photos, reviews, Q&A)

- Own our local SEO for the NW Indiana service area

- Oversee social media: you draft the content in Canva and Buffer, and nothing posts until the owner approves it



Scorekeeping (this is a big part of the job)

- Track the full funnel in our CRM: leads, then estimates scheduled, then booked jobs, then closed jobs

- Track cost per lead, close rate, and cost per booked job for each channel

- Keep our numbers clean and up to date in Google Sheets and the CRM

- Send the owner a clear weekly report: what's working, what isn't, and what you'd change



Planning ahead

- Propose campaigns, seasonal pushes (spring exterior season, winter interiors, and so on) and new lead channels before we have to ask

- Spot problems early, like lead volume dropping, cost per lead rising, or slow follow-up, and bring solutions



TOOLS WE USE

GoHighLevel (white-labeled as Local PRO Connect), Dripjobs CRM, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Business Profile, Buffer, Canva, Google Sheets



WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

- The owner (you report to him)

- Our existing VA, who handles lead callbacks

- Our sales/estimating lead

- Our production manager



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience running both Meta Ads and Google Ads that produced leads for local or home-service businesses

- Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel or a similar CRM/funnel tool

- Comfortable with numbers: you can build and read reports and explain them in plain English

- Strong written English

- Reliable internet and a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Some regular overlap with US Central time (at least 4 hours a day between 8 AM and 5 PM CT)



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with painting, HVAC, roofing, plumbing, landscaping or other home-service companies (a big plus)

- Experience with Dripjobs or other contractor CRMs

- Google Ads and/or Meta Blueprint certifications

- Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization experience

- Basic landing page or funnel building inside GoHighLevel

- Canva skills for ad creatives



WHAT WE OFFER

- Full-time, long-term position: $800–$1,200 per month

- Raises based on results and tenure

- Direct access to the owner. Your ideas get heard, and if they work they get used.

- A chance to build the marketing function at a growing local company instead of being one of many accounts at an agency



HOW TO APPLY



Please read this part carefully. Generic copy-paste applications will be skipped.



1. Start your application with the phrase: PAINT LEADS

2. Answer these 5 questions:



   (1) Tell us about a home-service or local business you ran Meta or Google Ads for. What was the monthly ad budget, the cost per lead, and the number of leads per month?



   (2) How would you track a lead from first click to closed job? Walk us through your process and tools.



   (3) Which CRMs and funnel tools have you used? Have you used GoHighLevel? If so, what did you build or manage in it?



   (4) What is your expected monthly rate, and which hours can you work in US Central time?



   (5) Share a link to a portfolio, case study, or a short Loom video (under 5 minutes) showing a campaign you ran and its results.



3. Attach or link your resume.



Applications without "PAINT LEADS" at the top or without answers to all 5 questions won't be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview.



We look forward to hearing from you.



Damian Raber

Smooth Finish Painting LLC

title: Amazon trading expert
description:
AMAZON MARKETPLACE TRADING & LISTING OPTIMISATION SPECIALIST (REMOTE VA)



Company: Talking Tables

Location: Remote

Type: Long-term, ongoing opportunity

Experience: Proven Amazon trading and listing optimisation experience required. Vendor Central experience preferred.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced Amazon Marketplace Trading Specialist to take ownership of a selection of our products (SKUs) and focus entirely on improving their sales performance, visibility and profitability on Amazon.



This is not an administrative VA role. We are looking for someone who understands how to grow sales on Amazon, can identify opportunities through data and competitor research, and knows how to turn those insights into measurable results.



You will be responsible for managing and optimising a portfolio of products, identifying what is holding back their performance and implementing improvements to drive growth.



We want someone who is proactive, analytical and commercially minded, rather than someone who simply completes tasks when instructed.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. LISTING OPTIMISATION & SEO



- Optimise product titles, bullet points, descriptions and backend search terms.

- Conduct keyword research to improve organic visibility and rankings.

- Review and improve product imagery, A+ Content and overall listing quality.

- Identify underperforming listings and implement improvements.

- Continuously test, review and refine listings based on performance data.



2. COMPETITOR & MARKET ANALYSIS



- Research competing products, brands and market trends.

- Analyse competitor pricing, positioning, imagery, keywords and content.

- Identify gaps and opportunities where our products can gain market share.

- Review pricing structures and recommend changes to improve competitiveness and profitability.

- Identify successful competitor strategies that could be applied to our listings.



3. DATA ANALYSIS & PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT



- Analyse Amazon performance data to understand what is driving or limiting sales.

- Diagnose issues such as declining sales, low conversion rates, poor visibility or reduced competitiveness.

- Use data to identify opportunities for growth and prioritise improvements.

- Monitor sales, conversion, traffic, keyword rankings and profitability.

- Track and report on the impact of listing changes, showing measurable results.



4. SKU OWNERSHIP & TRADING STRATEGY



- Take full ownership of an assigned portfolio of SKUs.

- Develop and implement an ongoing optimisation strategy for each product.

- Prioritise products and actions based on their potential commercial impact.

- Proactively suggest new ideas and improvements without waiting for instructions.

- Provide regular updates on what has been changed, why, and the results achieved.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essential:



- Proven experience growing sales and improving product performance on Amazon.

- Strong knowledge of Amazon SEO, keyword research and listing optimisation.

- Experience conducting competitor research and pricing analysis.

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to diagnose performance issues using data.

- Experience using Amazon analytics and keyword research tools.

- A clear understanding of the relationship between traffic, conversion, pricing and profitability.

- Ability to work independently and take genuine ownership of results.



Highly Desirable:



- Experience working with Amazon Vendor Central (1P), rather than solely Seller Central (3P).

- Experience using tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout or similar.

- Experience managing and optimising products across multiple Amazon marketplaces, including the UK, US and Europe.

- Experience working with established consumer brands and competitive product categories.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



We are not measuring success by how many listings you edit or how many tasks you complete.



We want to see genuine improvements in the performance of the SKUs you manage, including:



- Increased sales and revenue.

- Improved organic search visibility and keyword rankings.

- Higher conversion rates.

- Stronger competitiveness against similar products.

- Improved profitability where possible.

- Clear, data-backed explanations of what has worked and what hasn't.



We expect you to treat your assigned products as your own portfolio and continuously look for ways to improve their performance.



HOW TO APPLY – IMPORTANT



We are only interested in candidates who can demonstrate previous success optimising Amazon listings.



Please include the following in your application:



1. Examples of Amazon listings you have personally worked on, ideally with ASINs or links to the products.

2. Evidence of the results you achieved, such as before-and-after sales performance, conversion rate improvements, keyword ranking changes or other relevant metrics. Screenshots or reports are welcome.

3. An explanation of what you actually did to achieve those results. We want to understand your personal contribution, not just the overall account performance.

4. Your experience with Amazon Vendor Central, if applicable, including which marketplaces you have managed.

5. The tools you use for competitor analysis, keyword research, listing optimisation and performance tracking.



Please also briefly explain how you would approach taking over a portfolio of 20 underperforming Amazon SKUs and deciding which improvements to prioritise.



Applications without relevant examples of previous work and measurable results are unlikely to be considered.



WHAT WE OFFER



- A long-term opportunity with an established UK consumer products brand.

- The opportunity to take real ownership of a portfolio of Amazon products.

- A focused role dedicated to trading, optimisation and commercial growth.

- Remote working with the potential for an ongoing working relationship.



We're looking for someone who can make a measurable difference to our Amazon performance, not simply maintain our existing listings.

title: Long-Form YouTube Editor for Finance Education Channel (Documentary Style) - Part-Time, Growth to Full-Time
description:
Long-Form YouTube Editor for Finance Education Channel (Documentary Style) 



Type of employment:

Part Time



Job description:



About the channel



I run The Capital Vault, a US-based capital advisory that helps established business owners ($2M-$20M revenue) secure growth capital for buyouts, acquisitions, expansions, and debt restructures. I’m building a YouTube channel that explains how business financing actually works: why banks say no, how lenders read a P&L, how a $2M deal actually gets structured, and the parts of the money system nobody explains to business owners.



The audience is business owners, operators, and people who want to understand capital. The tone is an insider pulling back the curtain. Not hype, not “get rich,” not finance-bro content. Think of it as the finance channel that respects the viewer’s intelligence.



I’m looking for a long-form editor who can turn my raw talking-head recordings into polished, high-retention videos that match a specific visual style.



The video style (this is the important part)



Every video follows the same visual language. Before you apply, make sure this is a style you can execute and enjoy:



Documentary feel, not vlog feel. Think clean, cinematic, deliberate. Reference the pacing and polish of channels like Johnny Harris, Ali Abdaal’s long-form explainers, and the Hormozi-style business breakdowns. Confident cuts, no jump-cut chaos.

High contrast, dark and clean. Deep navy and black backgrounds, gold accents for emphasis. Minimal color palette. Everything looks expensive and intentional.

Numbers on screen, always. This is a finance channel, so every key figure ($2M deal, 60 days, 27-point approval gap) appears as bold on-screen text the moment I say it. Big, clean, sans-serif, animated in with subtle motion.

Charts and explainers that teach. When I explain a concept (DSCR, a capital stack, why a bank declined a file), you build a simple animated graphic that makes it click: bars rising, a flow diagram, a before-and-after comparison. Simple beats fancy. The graphic exists to make the idea land, not to show off.

Captions on everything. Clean, readable, styled to match the brand. Key phrases highlighted.

B-roll that’s relevant and original. Screen recordings, documents, my own footage, custom graphics. No generic stock footage of handshakes and skylines. If a visual doesn’t add meaning, it doesn’t go in.

Hooks that hold. The first 30 seconds are tight and visual: the claim, the number, the question, on screen fast. You understand retention curves and cut for them.

No gimmicks. No zoom-in-every-3-seconds, no meme sound effects, no over-edited energy. Calm authority. The edit should feel like the viewer is being let in on something.



If you can watch a 15-minute Johnny Harris or a Hormozi breakdown and explain why the edit holds attention, you’ll understand what I’m after.



What you’ll do



Edit 1-2 long-form videos per week (8-20 minutes final length) from raw talking-head footage I record, plus a script for each

Cut filler, tighten pacing, and structure the video so retention holds from the hook to the close

Build the on-screen text, number callouts, captions, and simple animated charts and explainers that illustrate financial concepts

Build clean intros, chapter cards, transitions, and end screens in the brand style

Source or create relevant B-roll (screen recordings, documents, graphics), never generic stock

Deliver a first cut within 48-72 hours, revisions within 24

Study my past videos and the reference channels I share, match the style, then improve on it over time

Flag anything in the footage that could be stronger (a better order, a cut that would hold attention better). I want an editor with opinions.



What I’m looking for



2+ years editing long-form YouTube content, with a portfolio of 8-20 minute videos you’ve personally cut

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts: you know how to hold attention for 15 minutes, not just 15 seconds

Clean motion graphics and text animation (simple, professional, consistent)

Comfortable turning numbers I give you into simple charts and visual explainers

Proficient in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (After Effects a plus)

Reliable, communicative, and able to work independently from a brief

Comfortable with finance and business content (no finance background required, but you take the material seriously and ask when you don’t understand a concept)

Bonus: thumbnail design, short-form clipping from long-form (Opus Clip, Vizard), or experience with educational/explainer channels



How we’ll work



Paid trial: you’ll edit one long-form video from footage and a script I provide, so we can both see if the fit is right

Clear brief and script for every video, feedback in writing, workflow in Slack

Payment every two weeks via bank transfer

Original B-roll and graphics only. No generic stock footage.

Consistent weekly volume. This is a steady role, not one-off gigs.



To apply, include



Links to 3-5 long-form YouTube videos you edited (8+ minutes). Educational, finance, business, or documentary-style content preferred.

One sentence on why the edit in your best sample holds attention

Your editing software

Your availability per week and your rate



Start your application with the words “CAPITAL VAULT” so I know you read the full post.



I’m looking for someone to grow with. If the trial goes well, this becomes a steady long-term role, with the option to expand into short-form clipping, thumbnails, and a larger content operation as the channel grows.



Wage/Salary:

$500-$900/month (part-time, based on experience and output), with growth to full-time





:





Business or Contact Name (public):

The Capital Vault



Skills (select up to 3):

Video Editing, Motion Graphics, YouTube Content Creation

title: B2B Appointment Setter / Cold Caller - Med Spa Industry
description:
About Velo Systems



Velo Systems helps established med spas improve how they handle inbound calls and booking opportunities using AI-powered receptionist technology.



We are currently building our outbound sales team and are looking for an experienced B2B appointment setter who is confident speaking with business owners and decision-makers.



This is a sales position, not a basic virtual assistant or data-entry role.



You will be responsible for starting conversations with med spa owners, identifying potential problems around missed or unanswered calls, handling objections, and booking qualified appointments for our closer.



You will not be responsible for closing the final sale.



What You’ll Do



Your main responsibility is to generate qualified sales appointments through outbound calling.



You will:



- Make outbound cold calls to med spas

- Speak with business owners and decision-makers

- Navigate receptionists and gatekeepers

- Identify potential pain around missed or unanswered calls

- Create interest in Velo Systems

- Handle common objections

- Lightly qualify prospects

- Book qualified appointments

- Follow up with interested prospects

- Confirm appointments

- Keep the CRM updated

- Maintain consistent daily activity



The sales process is simple:



Cold call → Conversation → Light qualification → Appointment → Closer



Our closer handles the deeper discovery, demonstration, pricing, objections, and closing.



Who We’re Looking For



Required



- 2+ years of proven B2B cold calling or appointment-setting experience

- Strong spoken English

- Confident and professional phone presence

- Experience speaking with business owners or decision-makers

- Strong objection-handling ability

- Ability to have natural conversations instead of simply reading a script

- Strong follow-up habits

- Reliable internet connection

- Quiet workspace

- Ability to consistently work 9 AM - 5 PM Eastern Time



Experience selling marketing services, SaaS, AI, agency services, healthcare, med spa services, or other B2B services is a strong advantage.



We care more about what you have actually produced than how impressive your resume sounds.



What We’re Looking For



You should be comfortable hearing:



“Not interested.”



“Just send me an
.”



“We already have a receptionist.”



“How much does it cost?”



“I’m too busy.”



“Call me later.”



You should be able to stay calm, think on your feet, and keep the conversation moving without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.



You should also know when a prospect is not a good fit.



We care about qualified appointments, not simply filling the calendar.



Daily Activity



Our initial target is approximately:



100 to 150 outbound attempts per day



This is not a competition to make meaningless calls.



We care about the entire funnel:



Calls → Conversations → Decision-makers → Qualified prospects → Appointments → Shows → Clients



A setter who makes 150 poor calls is not more valuable than someone who makes 100 high-quality calls and consistently produces qualified opportunities.



Compensation



$500 USD/month base



Plus:



Uncapped performance bonuses



Performance bonuses are tied to qualified appointments that attend and clients generated from your appointments.



There is no ceiling on performance earnings.



The exact bonus structure will be explained during the interview.



Our goal is to reward people who actually produce results.



Training



You will not simply receive a phone number and be told to start dialing.



Before working with live leads, you will receive training on:



- Velo Systems

- Our AI receptionist solution

- Our target market

- Cold-call structure

- Receptionist and gatekeeper handling

- Qualification

- Objection handling

- Appointment booking

- Calendly

- CRM usage

- Follow-up

- Appointment confirmation



You will also complete roleplay before beginning live outbound.



How We Measure Performance



We track the entire sales funnel:



Outbound Attempts

↓

Connections

↓

Decision-Maker Conversations

↓

Qualified Prospects

↓

Appointments Booked

↓

Appointments Showed

↓

Closed Clients



We use these numbers to identify where the sales process can be improved.



You will also receive coaching based on actual recorded calls.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term position with the company.



As the sales operation grows, there will be opportunities for increased earning potential and additional responsibility for strong performers.



Application Process



Please answer every question below.



Incomplete applications will not be considered.



1. How many years of B2B cold-calling experience do you have?



2. How many years of appointment-setting experience do you have?



3. What industries or types of businesses have you previously called?



4. Were your leads primarily cold, warm, inbound, or a mixture?



Please explain.



5. Approximately how many outbound calls did you make per day in your previous role?



6. Approximately how many qualified appointments did you generate per week or month?



7. What was your approximate appointment show rate?



If you don’t know, just say so.



8. Who were you typically calling?



For example:



- Business owners

- CEOs

- Managers

- Receptionists

- Consumers



9. What countries were you calling?



10. What was the most difficult objection you regularly encountered, and how did you handle it?



Roleplay Question 1



Imagine you’re calling a med spa owner.



They say:



“We already have a receptionist. We’re not interested in an AI receptionist.”



What would you say?



Write your response exactly as you would say it on the phone.



Roleplay Question 2



The owner says:



“Just send me an
.”



What would you say?



Voice Recording



Please provide a 60 to 90 second voice recording introducing yourself.



Tell us:



- Your sales experience

- Your cold-calling experience

- What type of businesses you’ve called

- Why you believe you’d be a strong fit for this position

- We want to hear your natural speaking voice, confidence, communication style, and professionalism.



Work Setup



Please confirm that you have:



- Reliable computer

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Quality headset/microphone

- Quiet workspace

- Ability to work 9 AM - 5 PM Eastern Time



Attention to Detail



At the very end of your application, include:



VELO SALES



This lets us know that you read the entire job post.

title: Real Estate Cold Caller — Part-Time, Remote (US Hours)
description:
About the role:

I'm a real estate investor buying houses in the Dallas–Fort Worth area. I need a cold caller to work from a list I provide, follow my script, talk to homeowners, and book appointments with motivated sellers. You dial and qualify — I close.



Hours & pay:

- 20 hours/week to start (4 hrs/day, Mon–Fri), can grow to full-time

- US Central time business hours (Dallas market)

- $4–7/hr depending on experience, paid weekly via Wise/Payoneer

What you get from me:

- The call list (already built — you don't find leads)

- The exact script (rapport opener + qualification: motivation, condition, time frame, price)

- Short training: I'll walk you through the script on the first call

- Cold calling or telemarketing experience (real estate a big plus)

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, headset

1. A 60-second voice recording: introduce yourself and read this line naturally — "Hey, is this John? Hey John, this is [your name] — how's your day going so far?"

Serious applicants only — this is a real, ongoing position, not a one-week gig.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are building a remote video production company that helps businesses, agencies, real estate companies, and other professionals turn raw footage into high-quality social media content.

This is not a one-off project. Our goal is to build a reliable editing team and increase your workload as we bring on more clients.



What you'll be editing

- TikTok videos

- YouTube Shorts

- Talking-head videos

- Business/marketing videos

- Real estate videos

- Interviews and other social media content



You'll take raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging content.

Your responsibilities:

- Cut and pace videos professionally

- Add captions/subtitles

- Add B-roll when appropriate

- What moments should be emphasized

- Where B-roll would improve the video

Tell us how many hours per week you are currently available.

5. Desired rate

Rate will be determined by experience 

6. Your internet/computer setup

Briefly tell us about your computer and internet connection.

7. Answer this question:

What makes a short-form video engaging and keeps someone watching until the end?



Hiring Process:

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short paid editing test using provided footage.

We are looking for someone who can become a dependable long-term part of our team, so we're much more interested in quality, reliability, and communication than simply finding the cheapest editor.

If you're interested in building something long-term with us, we'd love to hear from you.

 and have 1.2M followers on Instagram. Our founder, Alanna, is a footwear designer trained in Florence and formerly at Kate Spade and Macy's.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a full-time, remote Video Editor & Social Media Specialist to edit our YouTube and short-form video, run our community, and keep our socials looking sharp. You'll work directly with Alanna across YouTube, TikTok and Instagram. This is a hands-on creative role for someone who edits fast and well, has an eye for what looks expensive, and gets things done without being chased.



WHAT MATTERS MOST (IN ORDER)

1. Video editing: this is the core of the role. Your portfolio should show strong pacing, storytelling and polish

2. Proven taste: you can show work that looks premium and on-trend, and you know the difference between good and great

3. Ambition and ownership: you work independently, take initiative, and get things done remotely without needing to be managed



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Video Editing (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram)

- Edit long-form YouTube videos from raw footage: pacing, cuts, color, sound, captions, b-roll and graphics

- Design 2–3 thumbnail options for every YouTube video, with title and hook suggestions

- Cut, reformat and polish short-form video for TikTok and Instagram Reels

- Repurpose long-form footage into shorts and keep a library of reusable clips



Instagram Content

- Create static posts, carousels and Stories for our main account and the VICE VERSA account

- Keep both feeds visually consistent with the brand's look and tone

- Help schedule and publish content on the agreed calendar



Community Management

- Monitor comments and DMs daily across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube

- Reply to comments in a warm, friendly, on-brand voice

- Flag anything important: customer issues, recurring questions, product feedback, press or partnership interest, and negative trends

- Send a short weekly summary of what people are saying



AI and Automation

- Manage and optimize our ManyChat integration: DM flows, keyword triggers, lead capture and link delivery

- Oversee the AI tools running on our Instagram, check their replies for accuracy and tone, and fix or escalate problems

- Bring new AI tools and workflows that make editing, design and community work faster



Affiliate and Gifting Program

- Help run our creator gifting and affiliate program, from outreach to shipping coordination

- Track gifted products, posted content, affiliate links, codes and results in one place

- Follow up with creators and report on what's working



Photo Shoot Prep

- Build mood boards, shot lists and call sheets for upcoming shoots

- Research and shortlist shoot locations, mainly around New York City, with photos, costs and permit notes

- Help source references for styling, models, props and creative direction



MUST-HAVES

- Video editing experience: 2+ years editing for YouTube and short-form social. Fluent in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut

- Proven taste: a portfolio that shows a strong eye for composition, color, typography and luxury aesthetics

- Self-driven and reliable: a track record of working remotely, owning projects end to end, meeting deadlines and communicating proactively

- Social media experience: 2+ years managing Instagram and TikTok for a brand or creator

title: Customer Support Agent — DTC Supplement Brand (Subscription, High Volume, Phone + Email)
description:
Read carefully — this is a high-volume, high-standard support role.



We're a fast-growing DTC supplement brand running a subscription-first model with a large, active customer base. That means a lot of tickets, a lot of subscription questions, and customers who need fast, warm, accurate answers — over both
 and phone. We're hiring several experienced CS agents who can handle real volume without dropping quality.



This is not an entry-level role. If you've done real customer support for an ecommerce or subscription brand, your spoken and written English are excellent, and you're fast, empathetic, and unflappable, keep reading.



What you'll do



Handle a high volume of customer tickets daily —
, chat, and helpdesk

Handle phone support — speaking with customers directly, calmly, and clearly

Manage subscription issues: cancellations, pauses, skips, billing questions, failed payments, refunds

Handle chargebacks, disputes, and difficult customers calmly and professionally

Resolve shipping, tracking, and delivery inquiries

Follow our support scripts, policies, and escalation rules precisely

Keep response times fast and quality high, even under heavy load



Who we're looking for (strict requirements)



Proven CS experience for an ecommerce or DTC brand — not general call-center only. You understand online-store customers.

Experience with subscription/recurring-billing businesses — you understand rebills, cancellations, dunning, and how to handle a frustrated subscriber. This is essential.

Experience in the supplement / health / wellness space strongly preferred — you know how to talk to this customer and stay compliant (no medical claims).

Excellent English — written AND spoken. Our customers are US-based and mostly older, and this role includes phone support, so we need a clear, warm, easy-to-understand speaking voice with a neutral accent — not just strong writing. Tone and clarity on the phone matter as much as on
.

Hands-on with a helpdesk / ticketing tool — Gorgias, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Freshdesk or similar. Gorgias experience is a big plus.

Fast and accurate under volume — you can handle many tickets a day without sloppy replies.

Calm with angry or difficult customers — de-escalation is a core skill.

Reliable, self-managing, and available consistently for full coverage (we run support across extended hours, including weekends — flexibility required).



Bonus (stand out)



Experience with Shopify, chargeback handling, or fraud/dispute management

Experience writing or improving support macros/templates

Comfortable with high-empathy, older US customer demographics



Why this role



We treat CS as core to the business, not an afterthought. Strong agents get stability, growth, and a long-term role on a team that's scaling fast. We start with a paid trial so we both confirm the fit.



How to apply (follow exactly — this is the first filter)



Start your application with the word "RESOLVE" as the very first word. Applications without it are deleted unread.

In 2–3 sentences, describe the most difficult customer situation you've handled and how you resolved it.

Answer this: A customer messages angry that they were charged for a subscription they say they forgot about, and they're threatening a chargeback. How do you respond? (Give us your actual reply to the customer.)

Include a short voice sample. Record 30–60 seconds of you speaking in English — either introducing yourself, or (better) reading this as if to a customer: "Hi, thank you for calling HydroLabs, my name is ___. I completely understand your concern about the charge, and I'm going to help you sort this out right now." Send it as an audio file or link (Loom, Google Drive, WhatsApp voice note, etc.). Applications without a voice sample won't be considered.

Tell us: which helpdesk tools you've used, and whether you've worked with subscription and/or supplement brands (name them if you can).

No AI-written applications. We want to see how you actually write to a customer. AI-written applications are rejected.

State your rate and confirm you can work flexible/extended hours including weekends.



We read every application that follows these steps. If you're an experienced CS pro with great spoken English who thrives under volume, we want to hear from you.

title: Industrial Designer / Product Design Engineer – Modular Body Scrubber
description:
** Must apply at: 
 **



We are developing Pebble Scrub, a premium handheld body scrub system inspired by the smooth, organic shape of a river stone.



The product will feature a durable, reusable Pebble body with interchangeable scrubbing attachments, allowing customers to choose different textures and replace attachments while keeping the main body.



We are looking for an experienced Industrial Designer / Product Design Engineer to develop the product through material selection, ergonomic design, mechanical engineering, functional prototyping, and manufacturing preparation.



The goal is a product that feels comfortable, performs well in actual shower use, and can be manufactured at a commercially viable cost.



The product should include:



Reusable Pebble body: A compact, lightweight frame with a premium appearance, comfortable handling, and secure grip with wet, soapy hands. Final material, dimensions, and construction are open to your recommendations.



Interchangeable scrubbing attachments: Potential options include soft silicone, African-net-style exfoliating mesh, and a lathering sponge. Charcoal-containing sponge or textile options may also be explored.



Shared attachment system: A secure, discreet connection that supports different attachment materials and allows easy removal for replacement, rinsing, and drying.



Practical drying/storage solution: A hanging loop or another well-integrated solution.



We have explored an earlier concept and identified several areas requiring improvement: excessive size and weight, overly stiff silicone, and inadequate lathering. These findings will help guide development.



Your responsibilities will include:



Recommend suitable materials and manufacturing processes for the body, attachments, and any attachment carriers or backing components.



Develop the Pebble shape for comfortable use across different adult hand sizes.



Establish target dimensions and weight early, supported by printable sizing models and estimated production weight.



Evaluate attachment mechanisms such as mechanical retention, magnetic attachment, or another practical approach.



Ensure attachments remain secure during wet scrubbing, twisting, and repeated removal. If magnets are proposed, address corrosion protection and secure retention within the product.



Engineer a common connection that works with both molded silicone and textile/sponge attachments.



Develop and compare suitable silicone softness, thickness, and surface patterns through physical samples.



Address lathering, rinsing, drainage, drying, and access for cleaning.



Apply design-for-manufacturing principles, including wall thickness, draft, parting lines, tolerances, assembly, and tooling complexity.



Support prototype evaluation and revisions based on actual use.



Development should follow clear milestones, beginning with the body’s size, handling, material direction, and connection concept.



Early STL files are required so we can print sizing models in-house before detailed engineering proceeds. Functional prototypes should then be used to evaluate weight, wet grip, attachment security, scrubbing feel, and lathering before final manufacturing decisions.



Required deliverables include:



Editable native CAD files for all designed parts and assemblies.



STEP/STP files for manufacturing and supplier review.



STL files for early sizing checks and subsequent prototypes.



Dimensioned drawings with critical interface dimensions and tolerances.



Exploded assembly views and a bill of materials.



Material, surface finish, and manufacturing recommendations.



A prototype/testing plan and documented revisions.



Updated design files following agreed manufacturer DFM feedback.



For textile or sponge attachments, provide appropriate material and assembly specifications alongside CAD for their carriers.



We will provide concept images, reference products, written requirements, feedback from earlier prototype testing, and clear feedback throughout development.



Please include the following in your application:



Two or three relevant physical products you personally designed or engineered. Explain your role and whether they reached manufacturing.



Your CAD software and the editable file formats you can provide.



Your experience with injection-molded plastics, silicone components, and interchangeable attachment systems.



Any experience with personal-care products, wet-use products, or textile/sponge integration.



How you would validate size, weight, and attachment performance early.



Your proposed milestones, availability, and timeline for the first printable sizing models.



Your estimated fees, included revision rounds, and any prototype or supplier coordination services you offer.



This is a project-based opportunity with a flexible budget for the right expertise. Please identify design fees and external prototype/manufacturing expenses separately.



Clear communication, weekly progress updates, and delivery of current CAD files at agreed milestones are essential.

You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Current needed shifts: Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Hubstaff time tracking during shifts.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

title: US Tax Preparer (1040/1065/1120-S/1120) - Drake - CPA-Led US Firm - Part-Time, Full-Time in Tax Season
description:
ABOUT US

Prime & Ledger CPAs is a US CPA firm (Arkansas) serving small businesses nationwide - especially restaurants, salons and their owners. The firm is led by a CPA with Big Four and large-corporate tax experience. We prepare individual, partnership, S corporation and C corporation returns, plus FICA tip credit (IRC Section 45B) amended returns.



We work differently from most firms: we built our own tax preparation software ("P&L") that imports last year's return, bulk-imports client data, computes the return, and reconciles it against Drake Tax before filing. You will be trained on it. We want someone who wants to work accurately and efficiently with good tools - not someone who wants to key every number by hand.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Part-time (about 4 hours/day) year-round, moving to full-time (8 hours/day) January 15 - April 30 and August 15 - October 15.

- $7 - $10 per hour depending on experience and test results (about $600 - $900/month part-time; $1,200 - $1,800/month full-time in season). Raises for accuracy and turnaround.

- Flexible hours, but you must overlap at least 4 hours daily with US Central Time (e.g., 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM CT = 9:00 PM - 1:00 AM Philippine time).



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Import prior-year returns into our software and verify every extracted line and carryforward (capital loss, passive loss, QBI, Section 179, NOL).

- Organize client documents and bulk-import W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, 1098s, trial balances and payroll data.

- Prepare Forms 1040 (Schedules A, B, C, D/8949, E, SE), 1065, 1120-S and 1120, including K-1s, depreciation (Form 4562) and state returns.

- Reconcile each return in our software to Drake Tax line by line, explain every difference, and clear Drake diagnostics and e-file messages.

- Compare each return to the prior year and explain significant changes.

- Write clear review notes for the CPA reviewer and resolve review comments promptly.

- Draft open-items lists for clients (no direct client contact unless asked).

- Off-season: bookkeeping clean-up, payroll reports for FICA tip credit analysis, and extensions.



MUST HAVE

- At least 2 full US tax seasons PREPARING returns (not only data entry) for a US CPA or EA firm.

- Hands-on experience with Form 1040 AND at least one of Form 1065 or 1120-S.

- Professional tax software experience. Drake strongly preferred; UltraTax, Lacerte, ProSeries, ProConnect or CCH accepted.

- Solid understanding of K-1s, basis, depreciation, and Schedule C/E reporting.

- Excellent written English; comfortable following checklists and written procedures.

- Reliable internet with backup power (UPS or generator) and a quiet, private workspace.

- A US PTIN, or willingness to obtain one when hired.

- Willing to sign an NDA, confidentiality and data-protection agreements, and provide an NBI clearance.



NICE TO HAVE

- Philippine CPA, or US EA / CPA candidate.

- Restaurant, salon or hospitality clients; payroll registers; Form 8846 (FICA tip credit).

- Multi-state returns, BBA partnership rules, Form 7203.

- QuickBooks Online or Xero.



SECURITY (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

You will work only inside our secure remote environment. No client data on personal devices, no downloads, no screenshots, no copying files outside our systems. Access is monitored. These rules protect our clients under US federal law (IRC Section 7216).



HOW WE HIRE

1. Apply using the instructions below.

2. Short video call (20 minutes).

3. PAID test: prepare a sample return with planted issues in our software and Drake, then write review notes.

4. 30-day paid trial, then a long-term role.



HOW TO APPLY (follow exactly or your application will not be reviewed)

Start your application with "P&L Tax Season Ready" and answer:

1. How many US tax seasons have you worked, for what type of firm, and which return types did you prepare yourself?

2. Which tax software have you used, and for how many seasons? If Drake, which years?

3. Describe one difficult return you prepared and how you resolved the issue.

4. Do you have a PTIN? Will you get one if hired?

5. Your expected hourly rate, and whether you can work full-time January 15 - April 30.

title: Senior Accounts Payable Officer
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team and support the day-to-day accounts payable operations of an Australian company.



The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately processing supplier invoices, maintaining vendor accounts, reconciling transactions, and ensuring payments are processed accurately and on time. The role will primarily use Dext and Xero will work closely with the Australian finance and operations teams.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong attention to detail who enjoys working with numbers, following and improving processes, and maintaining accurate financial records.



What you'll do

-Process and code supplier invoices accurately in Dext and Xero

-Organize scheduled payments and prepare them for approval

-Handle urgent payments through Airwallex

-Respond to supplier queries and collaborate with the team on Slack

-Support month-end tasks and share ideas for improving how we work



What we're looking for

-3+ years in AP or a similar finance role

-Experience in supporting Australian businesses

-Experience with Xero and Dext

-Strong attention to detail, with the ability to work quickly and accurately

-Reliable, organized, and takes ownership of their work

-Clear written English

-Bonus: experience improving or automating finance processes



What’s in it for you?



This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!

You'll join our team and build lead-generating websites for local home service businesses using an easy drag-and-drop builder. No coding is needed. You'll use AI tools to create the content and images, and a step-by-step checklist guides every site you build. We are looking for someone to grow with us for the long-term.



About Us

We're a fully remote team of 5 (3 in the US, 2 in the Philippines). Together, we've launched over 36 sites in the last 3 months, building local SEO websites for home service businesses. We've kept everyone on the team since we started. We put high trust in our people to work hard, so we don't micromanage. You won't be working alone: you'll be a real part of the team, and we win together. We believe in paying fairly, training properly, and growing together.



What a "Site" Means for Us

Each site includes 12 pages:

- 1 home page

- 6 service pages

- 3 local area pages

- Privacy policy and terms and conditions pages



Your Responsibilities

1. Build and publish websites. You will receive step-by-step guidance during your 2 week training period. Expectations are lower during your first month working independently (trial period). By the end of the month-long trial period we expect you to be ramped up to full output.

2. Follow our site-completion checklist in Notion so every site is built the same way, with consistent quality and structure.

3. Use AI tools to generate page content and images, then edit them for quality, accuracy, and natural readability.

4. Apply on-page SEO to every page: title tags, meta descriptions, headings, keywords, image alt text, and internal links.

5. Check every site before it goes live (mobile view, formatting, broken links, duplicate content) using the checklist.

6. Send a quick daily update to the team with a screenshot of your Notion progress bar as you check off tasks.



Required Skills and Experience

- Working knowledge of SEO basics (on-page SEO, keywords, search intent). Beginners with solid fundamentals are welcome. Applicants with advanced SEO experience preferred.

- Working comfortably with AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude for writing, and AI image generators. You don't need to be an expert, but you should already be using them.

- Proficient written and verbal English. We meet weekly over video, so comfort in communicating in English is preferred.

- Comfortable learning new software quickly, especially website builders and Notion



Nice to Have (we'll teach you if you don't have these)

- Experience with any website builder (WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, GoHighLevel, etc.)

- Local SEO experience



Soft Skills

- Curious and eager to grow. We want someone who plans to keep learning and building their skillset.

- A team player who communicates openly, asks for help when needed, and supports teammates

- Fast learner who enjoys picking up new tools

- Self-starter who works well without constant supervision

- Strong attention to detail

- Able to reliably complete tasks to company standard while thinking outside the box to improve existing processes



Schedule and Meetings

- Full-time, 40 hours/week

- Fully flexible hours. We care about output, not when you're online.

- We meet every Monday morning as a team over video to review progress and plan the week, with extra check-ins during the week as needed.

- Please be available 7-8 AM Philippine time for meetings.

- Extra hours may be available.



Pay and Benefits

- Base pay of
USD/month ($4.06-$5.00/hour), depending on experience and test results. Training and trial are both paid at your full base pay.

- Performance bonuses, including a bonus for consistently hitting your weekly output

- Quarterly reviews with potential raises, including when the company reaches key milestones

- 13th month pay, available after your trial period and prorated based on your time with the company

- 10 paid holidays

- Paid time off (PTO) that accrues based on years of service



Training and Growth

- Paid 2-week training on our site-building workflow, tools, and SEO process

- 1-month paid trial period after training

- As we grow, you'll have opportunities to learn new skills and take on different responsibilities within the team.



How to Apply

1.
 us with "I Build Sites That Rank" as the subject line. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

2. We'll reply with a 1-minute video introducing our recruitment team.

3. Reply with your own video (under 1 minute) introducing yourself and why you're interested.

4. Shortlisted applicants will complete a $40 paid test task. We provide the platform and instructions, and you'll follow our prompts to create the output using AI tools and show us your SEO skills.

5. Top candidates will start our 2-week paid training, followed by a 1-month paid trial.



Questions before applying? Ask away!

title: Meta Ads Specialist (Full-Time) — GrowFactor Group
description:
About us



GrowFactor Group runs multiple UK businesses. This role starts with Vital Glow — a growing, nurse-led medical aesthetics and IV therapy clinic — and expands to running paid ads across our group of businesses (including GrowFactor) once you've proven yourself.



Vital Glow's Meta ads have worked well before (leads at £5–8 each). We want someone who lives and breathes paid ads — constantly building, testing, tweaking, and scaling — so we're always improving, never standing still.



The role



We're hiring a full-time Meta Ads specialist to own our paid acquisition. This is a hands-on, always-on role for someone who genuinely enjoys the daily craft of running ads: launching new creatives, killing losers, scaling winners, testing relentlessly.



How it works: You'll start focused 100% on Vital Glow through a paid trial period. Once you've shown you can deliver, the role expands to managing ads across the wider group (GrowFactor and others) — a full-time, long-term position with room to grow into a lead role.



What you'll own



Campaign management: Build, launch, and manage Meta lead-gen campaigns 
 + Instagram).

Constant testing & iteration: Always be adding new ads, testing hooks/creatives/audiences, and refining. We want momentum, not set-and-forget.



Optimisation: Monitor daily, manage budgets, kill underperformers, scale winners, drive down cost-per-qualified-lead.

Lead forms: Build and test Meta Instant Forms with qualifying questions (including higher-friction variants — SMS verification, screening).



Audiences: Build and maintain custom + lookalike audiences from client lists.



Reporting: Clear weekly reports — spend, leads, cost per lead, what changed and why.



Compliance-aware: These are regulated medical businesses. You'll follow the rules (e.g. never naming prescription-only treatments like "Botox" with a price in ad copy — we brief you fully).



Later — group scope: Once proven on Vital Glow, run and scale ads for GrowFactor and other group businesses.

You must have



Proven Meta Ads Manager experience (min. 2–3 years), strong in lead-generation campaigns.

Hands-on with Meta Instant Forms / lead ads.

Solid grasp of custom audiences, lookalikes, pixel/conversion setup, and testing methodology.

A genuine tester's mindset — you get satisfaction from iterating and improving.

Strong written English and clear communication.

Reliable computer, fast internet, able to work to UK business context/hours for reporting.

Available full-time.



Nice to have



Experience with aesthetics, beauty, wellness, or health clients (and UK ad rules for these).

GoHighLevel familiarity (our CRM — leads flow from ads into GHL).

Experience integrating lead ads with a CRM / instant follow-up.

Experience running ads across multiple brands/accounts at once.



Compensation



Paid trial period first, then long-term full-time.

Guaranteed on-time monthly payment. Paid leave. Real room to grow into a lead role as the group scales.

To apply — read carefully (applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed)



**Start your application with the phrase "Glow leads done right" so we know you read this**



In 2-3 sentences, describe your experience running Meta lead-generation campaigns specifically (not just boosting posts or ecommerce).



Share 1-2 examples (screenshots or numbers) of lead-gen results - cost per lead, volume, or an account you improved.



Answer this: You inherit an account running many ads at a tiny daily budget each, with cheap leads that aren't converting to bookings. What are the first three things you change, and why?



Tell us how you like to test and iterate - what does your weekly ads routine look like?

title: Appointment Setter / CRM Manager — Aesthetics Clinic (UK Hours) | Vital Glow
description:
Appointment Setter / CRM Manager — Aesthetics Clinic (UK Hours) | Vital Glow



Vital Glow is a growing, nurse-led medical aesthetics and IV therapy clinic in the UK. We're hiring one reliable, phone-confident Appointment Setter to keep our pipeline full, book qualified consultations, and keep our CRM clean.



This is a phone-heavy role. If you're not comfortable making outbound calls and speaking warmly with UK-based enquirers every day, this isn't the role for you. Your core job is simple to describe and hard to do well: call leads, revive old ones, book qualified consultations, and keep GoHighLevel accurate.



Because we're a regulated medical clinic, you'll represent us professionally and with care — you'll book consultations (not treatments), reassure nervous first-timers, and never give clinical advice. Warmth and trust matter more than hard selling here.



What you'll own:



Calling & setting: Call new and aged leads daily, qualify them against our criteria, and book qualified consultations directly into our calendar.

Lead reactivation: Systematically work through cold leads, no-shows, and stalled conversations by phone, WhatsApp and SMS — no lead left without a next step.

CRM management: Keep GoHighLevel pipelines, tags, stages, and notes updated immediately after every touch. Maintain a clean, actionable pipeline.

Follow-up & show-rate: Confirm booked consultations and follow up to reduce no-shows.

Ad hoc support: Light reporting, follow-up sequences, and helping our systems stay consistent.

Rebooking current clients and ensuring they repeat treatments. 



You must have:



Proven experience as an Appointment Setter, Sales VA, or Cold Caller (min. 1 year).

Strong spoken English and a confident, warm, professional phone presence — comfortable handling objections without being pushy.

Hands-on GoHighLevel experience (or a close equivalent: HubSpot, Keap, ActiveCampaign).

Reliable computer, fast internet, and a noise-cancelling headset (home-based role).

Willingness to work UK business hours.



Nice to have: Meta Ads familiarity, automation tools (Zapier, n8n), experience in aesthetics, wellness, healthcare, or beauty businesses.



Location: Philippines only. Home-based.



Compensation: [45,000-55,000]/month base (depending on experience) + commission per qualified consultation that shows. Guaranteed on-time monthly payment. Paid leave. Long-term role with room to grow into a lead manager position for strong performers.



To apply — read carefully (applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed):



Start your application with the phrase "Glow with Vital" so we know you read this.

In 2–3 sentences, describe your experience with outbound calling and lead reactivation specifically.

Tell us which CRM(s) you've used and what you did inside them.

Record a 60-second voice note introducing yourself, then pretending you're calling someone who enquired about an aesthetic treatment two weeks ago but never booked a consultation. Treat it like a real, warm call opener — reassuring, not salesy.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper & Financial Operations Specialist
description:
Eden Digital is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency providing SEO, paid advertising, website development, and digital marketing services to businesses across multiple industries.



We are looking for an experienced, dependable Bookkeeper & Financial Operations Specialist to help manage our day-to-day financial operations, maintain accurate records, develop and manage budgets, and keep our business finances organized.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working independently, takes ownership of responsibilities, and can proactively identify financial issues before they become problems.



We are not looking for someone who simply enters transactions into accounting software. We want someone who can help us stay financially organized, make informed budgeting decisions, and maintain healthy cash flow.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Client Invoicing & Accounts Receivable



- Create, schedule, and send recurring client invoices through QuickBooks Online.

- Ensure all clients are invoiced accurately and on time.

- Monitor incoming payments and reconcile payments against outstanding invoices.

- Follow up professionally with clients regarding overdue payments.

- Maintain accurate client billing records.

- Track outstanding invoices and anticipated incoming revenue.

- Identify and report billing discrepancies.



### 2. Accounts Payable & Bill Management



- Maintain an organized schedule of recurring business expenses, subscriptions, vendor invoices, and payment deadlines.

- Review upcoming bills and prepare payments for approval.

- Assist with scheduling approved payments and bank transfers.

- Monitor business credit card charges and recurring subscriptions.

- Periodically audit expenses to identify unnecessary, duplicate, or unused services.

- Flag unusual charges, billing errors, or opportunities to reduce expenses.

- Ensure financial obligations are tracked and addressed before their due dates.



### 3. Payroll & Contractor Payments



- Assist with preparing and processing payroll through our designated payroll platform.

- Track contractor invoices and scheduled payments.

- Verify payment amounts and due dates.

- Maintain organized payment records.

- Ensure payroll and contractor payments are prepared accurately and on schedule.

- Coordinate with our accountant when necessary.



### 4. Budgeting & Financial Planning



- Develop and maintain a realistic monthly operating budget.

- Track spending against the budget and identify overages.

- Help establish spending limits for recurring business expenses.

- Recommend adjustments to the budget based on revenue and financial obligations.

- Help determine appropriate allocations for operating expenses, payroll, taxes, savings, and debt repayment.

- Identify opportunities to reduce expenses and improve financial efficiency.

- Conduct monthly budget reviews and recommend adjustments.

- Help maintain financial accountability and prevent unnecessary spending.



### 5. Cash Flow & Debt Management



- Monitor cash balances and upcoming financial obligations.

- Maintain a rolling cash-flow forecast showing expected revenue and expenses.

- Help determine how much cash should remain available for operating expenses and financial reserves.

- Maintain a debt tracking system with outstanding balances, interest rates, minimum payments, and due dates.

- Develop and update a practical debt repayment plan.

- Recommend how much money can reasonably be allocated toward debt repayment each month.

- Help prioritize payments while protecting essential operating cash.

- Identify potential cash-flow shortages in advance.

- Prepare recommendations for transferring funds between business accounts when necessary.



### 6. Bookkeeping & Financial Reporting



- Maintain accurate financial records in QuickBooks Online.

- Categorize and reconcile bank and credit card transactions.

- Review account balances and investigate discrepancies.

- Maintain organized documentation of financial transactions.

- Prepare monthly profit and loss reports.

- Provide simple, easy-to-understand financial summaries.

- Coordinate with our U.S.-based CPA or accountant as needed.



## Weekly & Monthly Deliverables



**Weekly Financial Summary**



Provide a concise report showing:



- Current available cash balances.

- Outstanding client invoices and expected payments.

- Bills and payroll coming due.

- Estimated cash remaining after upcoming obligations.

- Recommended transfers or payments requiring approval.

- Any unusual expenses or financial concerns.



**Monthly Financial Review**



- Updated business budget.

- Budget versus actual spending.

- Monthly revenue and expense summary.

- Updated cash-flow forecast.

- Debt balances and recommended repayment allocations.

- Expense reduction opportunities.

- Reconciled financial records.



Reports should be straightforward, actionable, and easy to understand. We prefer clear recommendations over lengthy financial reports.



## Required Qualifications



- Minimum 2 years of professional bookkeeping experience.

- Experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

- Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online.

- Demonstrated experience with accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Experience preparing budgets and managing cash-flow forecasts.

- Familiarity with payroll and contractor payment processes.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

- Strong written and verbal English communication.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines consistently.

- Strong organizational skills and a proactive approach to financial management.

- Ability to handle confidential financial information professionally.

- Willingness to provide at least two verifiable professional references.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with digital marketing agencies or other service-based businesses.

- Experience managing recurring monthly client billing.

- Experience helping small-business owners develop budgets and debt repayment plans.

- Familiarity with U.S. business accounting practices.

- Experience identifying unnecessary business expenses and improving cash flow.



## What We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate is someone who:



- Takes ownership of responsibilities without needing constant reminders.

- Proactively identifies upcoming financial obligations.

- Notices discrepancies and investigates them.

- Understands the importance of protecting cash flow.

- Can make practical budgeting recommendations.

- Is comfortable managing multiple recurring financial tasks.

- Communicates clearly and provides regular updates.

- Values accuracy, confidentiality, and accountability.

- Is interested in building a long-term working relationship.



We want someone who helps us stay ahead of our finances rather than simply reporting what has already happened.



## Financial Access & Security



This position may involve access to confidential business financial information, accounting records, and payment preparation systems.



All significant financial transactions, bank transfers, and payments will require owner approval. The selected candidate will work within established access permissions and financial controls.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and overview of your bookkeeping experience.

2. Your experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

3. Your experience using QuickBooks Online.

4. Details about your experience creating budgets and managing cash flow.

5. An example of how you helped a previous client improve financial organization, reduce expenses, or manage payments. 

6. Your hourly rate and weekly availability.

7. Confirmation that you can provide two professional references from previous clients or employers.

title: Airbnb STR Remote Virtual Assistant
description:
We are seeking an experienced Virtual Assistant to support the day-to-day operations of our fast-growing short-term rental management company. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on guest communication, cleaning and maintenance coordination, administrative support, and timely completion of operational tasks.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling multiple properties and competing priorities. You will be expected to take ownership of assigned tasks from start to finish, resolve routine issues independently, and communicate clearly when additional support or approval is needed.



Work Schedule

- Full-time, fully remote: 40 scheduled hours per week, 8 hours per day.

- Flexible with shift schedules: Morning shift: 8am - 4pm, Evening shift: 4pm - 12am, Admin shift: 10am - 6pm.

- You must be flexible with all the shift schedules, including weekends. The schedule follows U.S. Pacific Time.



Note that all assigned work must be completed personally. Delegating or outsourcing work to sub-VAs or other individuals is strictly prohibited.





Key Responsibilities

Guest Communication & Reservation Support

- Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries through Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, direct-booking channels,
, and phone.

- Support guests throughout their stay, including booking inquiries, check-in instructions, access issues, amenity questions, and checkout.

- Resolve routine guest concerns and complaints within established policies and approval limits. Escalate urgent, sensitive, or high-cost issues with a clear summary and recommended next steps.

- Review reservation details, calendars, and special requests to identify potential issues and ensure accurate information.

- Assist with guest reviews, damage claims, disputes, and platform support cases by gathering documentation and following up.



Cleaning, Maintenance & Vendor Coordination

- Coordinate cleaning schedules and confirm that properties are ready before guest arrival.

- Follow up with cleaners on completion status, turnover photos, missing supplies, and reported property issues.

- Contact and coordinate with maintenance technicians, handymen, landscapers, and other service providers.

- Source vendors, request quotes, confirm availability, and arrange approved services.

- Track cleaning and maintenance issues through completion, verify that the work has been completed, and keep relevant parties informed.



Administrative & Listing Support

- Create and update property listings, descriptions, photos, amenities, house rules, and check-in instructions as assigned.

- Maintain accurate property information, guest records, vendor contacts, and operational documentation.

- Complete assigned updates in Hostaway, PriceLabs, and OTA platforms according to established procedures.

- Monitor listing alerts, guest feedback, and account notifications; flag issues promptly and complete required follow-up.

- Assist with property onboarding and setup on additional booking channels by organizing information and completing assigned configuration tasks.



Task Ownership & Operational Follow-Through

- Manage your assigned inboxes, tickets, and task queues, prioritizing time-sensitive guest and property issues.

- Take ownership of tasks from initial request through confirmed resolution—not just forwarding messages or creating tickets.

- Maintain clear notes on actions taken, current status, deadlines, and next steps so others can follow the work without unnecessary back-and-forth.

- Provide end-of-shift updates covering completed tasks, unresolved issues, pending approvals, and follow-up needs.

- Follow company SOPs, flag gaps or recurring problems, and suggest practical improvements based on day-to-day experience.





Qualifications

- Proven hands-on experience supporting short-term rentals on Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, or similar platforms.

- Familiarity with STR PMS.

- Excellent written and spoken English, including confidence communicating with guests and vendors by phone.

- Experience coordinating cleaning, maintenance, or other property-related services.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple properties, conversations, and deadlines.

- Sound judgment and problem-solving skills: able to handle routine issues independently, recognize urgency, and know when to escalate.

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable, with a strong habit of following up without repeated reminders.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and learning new software, tools, and procedures.

- Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable computer and headset, and a quiet workspace for guest and vendor calls.

- Ability to consistently work the required Pacific Time schedule and provide the stated standby availability.

How to Apply



Growth Opportunity

Top-performing Virtual Assistants may have the opportunity to advance into a VA Manager role as the company grows.



Please submit your application and complete every question in the application form. Only applicants who complete the full form will be considered.
